66427.recognize_zh: 低倍下骨小樑增厚、不規則且互相吻合（osteosclerosis），骨小樑間幾乎被呈漩渦狀、流線狀排列的梭形纖維組織取代，造血細胞與脂肪都明顯減少；這是纖維期骨髓纖維化的典型低倍樣貌。
features: Thickened, irregular, anastomosing bony trabeculae with new woven bone formation (osteosclerosis)
Intertrabecular spaces largely replaced by fibrous tissue with streaming, swirling spindle cells
Markedly reduced residual hematopoiesis and near-absent marrow fat
Reduced intertrabecular marrow space, with small marrow islands trapped within bone in the right half
Individual megakaryocyte morphology is not assessable at this magnification
66427.describe_en: Low-power H&E section of a bone marrow trephine shows marked architectural distortion. The bony trabeculae are thickened, irregular, and anastomosing, with areas of new bone formation that encroach on the marrow space. The intertrabecular spaces are largely replaced by fibrous tissue with a streaming spindle-cell pattern, and residual hematopoietic tissue and fat are markedly reduced. Megakaryocyte morphology cannot be assessed at this power, and reticulin/trichrome stains are required to grade fibrosis. Findings are consistent with an advanced fibrotic stage of myelofibrosis with osteosclerosis.

ddx.dx: Secondary myelofibrosis (post-PV/post-ET, metastatic carcinoma, granulomatous disease)
ddx.vs: Morphology can be identical at low power; history, JAK2/CALR/MPL status, and a search for carcinoma cells (keratin IHC) or granulomas separate them.
Fibrosis is predominantly peritrabecular with osteoclastic tunneling resorption rather than diffuse intertrabecular fibrosis with atypical megakaryocyte clusters.
Paratrabecular fibrotic aggregates contain spindle mast cells positive for tryptase and CD117 with CD25 aberrancy, often with eosinophils.
Presents acutely with increased CD34+ blasts and dysplastic small megakaryocytes on IHC, not a chronic course with osteosclerosis.

66363.recognize_zh: 一顆含四個大小相近圓形核的大型細胞，細胞質濃密、邊緣有小泡狀突起，旁邊一顆單核細胞也有相同的皺褶邊緣；右上方為馬蹄形核的巨噬細胞。多核加泡突狀細胞質邊緣是反應性間皮細胞的特徵。
features: Large multinucleated cell with four round-to-oval, similar-sized nuclei and fine chromatin
Dense basophilic cytoplasm with a fringe of surface blebs/microvilli
Adjacent mononuclear mesothelial cell with a round nucleus and similar ruffled cytoplasmic border
Macrophage with a horseshoe-shaped nucleus and pale cytoplasm (upper right); monocytoid cells at the lower left
Background of crenated and fragmented red cells; no marked nuclear pleomorphism
66363.describe_en: Cytocentrifuged pericardial fluid shows crenated red cells, macrophages with folded nuclei, and monocytoid cells. A large multinucleated cell with four uniform round nuclei and dense cytoplasm bordered by surface blebs is present, adjacent to a mononuclear mesothelial cell with a similar ruffled cytoplasmic edge. Nuclear chromatin is fine without hyperchromasia, marked pleomorphism, or macronucleoli. Findings are consistent with reactive mesothelial cells, including a multinucleated form.

ddx.vs: Malignant cells form three-dimensional clusters with nuclear pleomorphism, irregular membranes, prominent nucleoli, and cytoplasmic vacuoles, distinct from the uniform nuclei here.
Morphologic overlap exists; BAP1 loss, CDKN2A deletion, and marked atypia or numerous large cell balls favor mesothelioma.
Histiocytic giant cells have foamy, vacuolated cytoplasm with indistinct borders rather than dense cytoplasm with a bleb fringe.
Megakaryocytes have a single lobulated nucleus and granular pink cytoplasm rather than separate round nuclei in dense blue cytoplasm.

66299.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指的細胞充滿粗大、深紫黑色的嗜鹼性顆粒，幾乎遮蔽細胞核，即為嗜鹼性球（basophil）；背景可見分葉中性球、帶狀核中性球與較大的骨髓細胞/前骨髓細胞，呈左移的顆粒球系，符合慢性骨髓性白血病（CML）的背景。
features: Arrowed cell about the size of a neutrophil, densely packed with coarse dark purple-black granules
Granules overlie and obscure the nucleus, so nuclear lobation is not discernible
Background shows segmented neutrophils, band forms and larger immature granulocytes (myelocyte/promyelocyte-like cells) indicating a left shift
A small lymphocyte and scattered platelets; red cells normocytic without significant poikilocytosis
No blasts clearly identified in this field
66299.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a basophil (arrow) with abundant coarse, dark purple-black cytoplasmic granules obscuring the nucleus. The background contains increased granulocytes at various stages of maturation, including segmented neutrophils, bands and immature myelocyte-like forms, reflecting a left-shifted granulocytic series. Red cells and platelets are unremarkable in this field and no blasts are seen. In the clinical context, basophilia with a left-shifted myeloid series is consistent with chronic myeloid leukemia.

ddx.vs: Mast cells are larger with a round central nucleus and more uniform, less overlapping metachromatic granules, and are CD117/tryptase positive.
Toxic granulation is finer and dispersed with a clearly visible segmented nucleus, not coarse granules obscuring the nucleus.
Eosinophils have refractile orange-red uniform granules and a visible bilobed nucleus rather than blue-black granules.
Precipitate is irregular and extends beyond the cell border, while basophil granules are confined to the cytoplasm.

66235.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中只有兩顆血小板，且都明顯變大：左側一顆接近小紅血球大小、右側一顆也遠大於正常血小板，內含正常分布的紫紅顆粒；整個視野幾乎沒有正常大小的血小板，呈巨大血小板合併血小板減少的樣貌。
features: Two enlarged platelets: the left one approaching the diameter of an adjacent red cell, the right one also clearly larger than normal
Platelets contain evenly distributed azurophilic granules (not agranular or gray)
Marked paucity of platelets across the field, indicating thrombocytopenia
Red cells normocytic and normochromic without significant poikilocytosis; no platelet clumps
No leukocytes in the field, so neutrophil inclusions cannot be assessed
66235.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (Wright-Giemsa) shows markedly decreased platelets, with the few platelets present being enlarged, including one approaching red-cell size, and retaining normal azurophilic granulation. Red cells are normocytic and normochromic without significant poikilocytosis, and no platelet clumping is identified. Leukocytes are not present in this field to assess for Döhle-like inclusions. Findings of macrothrombocytopenia are consistent with an inherited giant platelet disorder such as Bernard-Soulier syndrome, to be confirmed by absent ristocetin-induced aggregation and reduced CD42b/GPIb expression by flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: ITP platelets are large but rarely red-cell–sized, and ristocetin-induced aggregation and GPIb expression are normal.
Giant platelets are accompanied by Döhle-like inclusions in neutrophils (not assessable in this field) and normal ristocetin response.
Gray platelets are large and pale/agranular because of absent alpha granules, unlike these granulated platelets.
Morphology is similar with mild or no bleeding; distinction requires GPIb-IX-V flow cytometry and genetic testing.

65979.recognize_zh: 上下兩顆細胞質布滿粗大、深紫黑色顆粒並覆蓋於核上的細胞為嗜鹼性球（basophil）；夾在中間的大細胞核質比高、染色質細緻、細胞質嗜鹼且無顆粒，為母細胞，背景為 AML 周邊血。
features: Two granulocytes (top and bottom) with coarse, dark purple-black granules scattered over the cytoplasm and overlying the nucleus
Basophil nuclei are partially obscured, with segmentation not clearly discernible
Central blast: large cell with high N:C ratio, finely dispersed chromatin and a thin rim of agranular basophilic cytoplasm
No Auer rods visible in the blast in this field
Background red cells with mild anisocytosis and scattered platelets
65979.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a large blast with a high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, finely dispersed chromatin, and a narrow rim of agranular basophilic cytoplasm, without Auer rods in this field. Flanking it are two granulocytes with coarse, dark purple-black cytoplasmic granules overlying and partially obscuring the nucleus, consistent with basophils. Red cells show mild anisocytosis and platelets are present. In the context of acute myeloid leukemia, findings show circulating blasts with accompanying basophils; basophilia in AML should prompt consideration of entities such as AML with t(6;9) DEK::NUP214 or BCR::ABL1-positive disease.

ddx.vs: Mast cells are larger with a round central nucleus and densely packed uniform granules, are rarely in blood, and express CD117 and tryptase.
Toxic granules are finer and do not heavily overlie a clearly segmented nucleus.
Eosinophils contain refractile orange-red granules with a bilobed nucleus rather than purple-black granules.
The central cell's fine open chromatin distinguishes it from a mature lymphocyte with condensed chromatin; lineage requires flow cytometry.

65851.recognize_zh: 箭頭指向單核球與嗜中性球細胞質邊緣的小顆、亮藍綠色折光性包涵體（blue-green inclusions），與一般嗜天青顆粒顏色不同；左圖單核球另有空泡。此發現與急性肝損傷相關，本例為單核球性 AML。
features: Small, sharply defined bright blue-green refractile cytoplasmic inclusions (arrows) in a monocyte and a neutrophil
Inclusions sit near the cell periphery and are distinct in color from the pink-purple azurophilic granules
Monocyte (left) with folded nucleus, grey-blue cytoplasm and several clear vacuoles
Right panel: segmented neutrophil with inclusions adjacent to additional monocytoid cells with folded nuclei
Background red cells with mild anisocytosis; no Auer rods seen in these fields
65851.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows monocytes and neutrophils, several of which contain one or more small, bright blue-green refractile cytoplasmic inclusions (arrows). A monocyte in the left panel additionally shows cytoplasmic vacuolation, and monocytoid cells with folded nuclei are present in the right panel. The inclusions differ from toxic granulation, Döhle bodies and Auer rods by their color and crystalline appearance. Findings are consistent with blue-green neutrophil/monocyte inclusions, a marker associated with acute liver injury and poor prognosis, seen here in a patient with monocytic acute myeloid leukemia.

ddx.vs: Döhle bodies are pale grey-blue, poorly demarcated peripheral cytoplasmic patches rather than small bright green refractile crystals.
Microorganisms have uniform shapes such as cocci, rods or budding yeasts with a basophilic purple stain rather than green refractility.
Auer rods are pink-red, needle-shaped azurophilic structures found in blasts or promyelocytes, not green inclusions in mature cells.
Iron-containing pigment is golden-brown and Prussian blue positive, whereas blue-green inclusions are thought to be lipofuscin-like and iron negative.

65787.recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀散佈圖，不是形態學影像：主要紅色群 CD4 與 CD8 皆陰性（雙陰性約 96.6%），且 TCRγδ 陽性、CD7 陽性；另外棕色 CD56+ 大顆粒淋巴球小群亦為 CD4/CD8 陰性為主。γδ T 細胞、雙陰性，符合肝脾 T 細胞淋巴瘤的免疫表型。
features: Plot 1: sCD3 versus CD56 on mononuclear cells, with a small CD56-positive, CD3-low LGL gate (brown) separate from the dominant CD3-positive population (red)
Plot 2: dominant red population is CD4 negative/CD8 negative (lower-left quadrant ~96.6%); residual CD4+ and CD8+ normal T cells in blue
Plot 3: red population is TCR gamma-delta positive and CD7 positive, separated from TCR gamma-delta negative normal T cells
Plot 4: the CD56-positive LGL gate is predominantly CD4/CD8 double negative (~91%) with a small CD8-positive fraction
CD56 appears negative on the dominant red population
65787.describe_en: This figure shows flow cytometry plots rather than a morphologic image. The dominant abnormal population (red) is surface CD3 positive, TCR gamma-delta positive and CD7 positive, and lacks both CD4 and CD8 (double negative in approximately 96% of events), with residual normal CD4 and CD8 T cells visible as minor populations. A small CD56-positive large granular lymphocyte gate is also mostly CD4/CD8 double negative. A marked expansion of CD4/CD8 double-negative gamma-delta T cells is abnormal and, together with clinical and genetic findings (isochromosome 7q, trisomy 8), is consistent with hepatosplenic T-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Reactive gamma-delta expansions are usually modest, polyclonal by TCR gene analysis, and lack i(7q) and aberrant antigen loss.

ddx.dx: T-cell large granular lymphocytic leukemia, gamma-delta type
ddx.vs: Gamma-delta T-LGL is typically CD57 and CD8 positive with granular morphology and lacks isochromosome 7q.
This entity presents with skin lesions and is often CD56 positive and cytotoxic-granule rich without hepatosplenic sinusoidal disease.
NK cells lack surface CD3 and TCR gamma-delta, are CD56 positive and are EBV associated.

65723.recognize_zh: 周邊血為中型淋巴球，核卵圓或有凹陷裂痕、染色質稍分散、核仁可見、胞質少；流式 CD5 陰性易誤判為邊緣區淋巴瘤，但切片 cyclin D1 弱陽性、FISH 顯示 IGH::CCND1 融合訊號（1R1G2F），確立為白血病性非結節性被套細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Blood: medium-sized lymphocytes with ovoid, indented or cleaved nuclei, slightly dispersed chromatin, distinct nucleoli and scant cytoplasm
Flow cytometry: B cells completely negative for CD5 in the CD5 vs CD20 plot
PAX5: numerous nuclear-positive B cells in the marrow
CD5: strong staining in scattered T cells with only weak staining in a subset of B cells
CD23 subset positive; cyclin D1 weak nuclear positivity in a subset; SOX11 negative
Interphase FISH with IGH/CCND1 dual-fusion probe showing 1 red, 1 green and 2 fusion signals
65723.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows medium-sized lymphocytes with ovoid to indented or cleaved nuclei, slightly dispersed chromatin, distinct nucleoli and scant cytoplasm. Marrow flow cytometry shows kappa-restricted B cells that are negative for CD5 and CD10 with dim CD23, whereas immunohistochemistry shows PAX5-positive B cells with weak subset CD5, subset CD23, weak nuclear cyclin D1 and negative SOX11. Interphase FISH demonstrates IGH::CCND1 fusion in most nuclei. Findings are consistent with leukemic non-nodal mantle cell lymphoma with weak to negative CD5 expression.

ddx.vs: SMZL cells may have villous cytoplasm and are CD5-negative, but they are cyclin D1-negative and lack IGH::CCND1.
CLL cells are small round lymphocytes with clumped chromatin, bright CD5 and CD23 and dim surface immunoglobulin, without cyclin D1 or CCND1 rearrangement.
HCL can show weak cyclin D1 but has abundant cytoplasm with hairy projections, CD103/CD25/CD11c/annexin A1 positivity and BRAF V600E, which was not detected.
LPL shows plasmacytoid differentiation, IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P, which was negative here.

65019.recognize_zh: 臨床照片可見前胸至上腹一大片密集的紅褐色細小丘疹與斑點，呈帶狀融合分布，並夾雜兩三顆較大的紫紅色丘疹；外觀類似脂漏性皮膚炎樣的濕疹狀皮疹，本身不具專一性，需切片及 CD1a/langerin 染色才能確診 LCH。
features: Numerous small reddish-brown papules and macules on the anterior chest and upper abdomen
Lesions coalesce into a broad band-like distribution across the trunk
Few scattered larger violaceous to red papules
Fine, slightly scaly eczematous appearance without vesicles or ulceration visible
Surrounding skin otherwise unremarkable
65019.describe_en: Clinical photograph of the anterior trunk shows numerous small reddish-brown papules and macules coalescing in a broad band across the chest and upper abdomen, with a few scattered larger violaceous papules. The eruption has an eczematous, seborrheic dermatitis-like appearance without visible vesicles, crusting, or ulceration. The appearance is nonspecific; in this clinical context, the findings are consistent with cutaneous Langerhans cell histiocytosis, which requires skin biopsy with CD1a and langerin (CD207) immunohistochemistry and BRAF V600E testing for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Inflammatory dermatitis lacks the dermal infiltrate of CD1a- and langerin-positive Langerhans cells with grooved nuclei on biopsy.
Petechiae are flat non-blanching purpuric macules, not scaly papules, and occur with a low platelet count.
Mastocytosis lesions urticate on rubbing (Darier sign) and show CD117/tryptase-positive mast cells on biopsy.

ddx.dx: Erdheim-Chester disease or other non-LCH histiocytosis
ddx.vs: Non-LCH histiocytes are CD68/CD163-positive and CD1a/langerin-negative.

65531.recognize_zh: 視野正中央有一顆比周圍顆粒球大好幾倍的細胞，細胞質深藍色、周緣冒出多個像「狗耳朵」的細胞質小突起（pseudopodia/blebs），核圓、染色質細而開。周圍幾乎只見顆粒球系、看不到成熟中的紅血球前驅細胞，是 parvovirus B19 巨大原紅血球的典型樣子。
features: Single giant cell roughly 3–4 times the diameter of adjacent neutrophils
Large round nucleus with finely dispersed, open chromatin and a pale central inclusion-like/nucleolar area
Moderate rim of intensely basophilic cytoplasm with a paler perinuclear zone
Multiple knob-like cytoplasmic blebs/pseudopodia ('dog ears') along the cell border
Background aspirate dominated by maturing granulocytes with conspicuous paucity of later erythroid precursors
65531.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows adequate cellularity composed predominantly of maturing granulocytic elements; maturing erythroid precursors are markedly reduced. A single giant proerythroblast is present, several times the size of neighboring neutrophils, with a large round nucleus, finely dispersed chromatin and a pale central inclusion-like area. The cytoplasm is deeply basophilic with a paler perinuclear zone and multiple ear-like cytoplasmic blebs. Findings are consistent with a giant proerythroblast of parvovirus B19 infection with pure red cell aplasia.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic anemia shows erythroid hyperplasia with many large maturing precursors and nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony, not a solitary giant proerythroblast with absent erythroid maturation.
Erythroid leukemia shows sheets of pronormoblasts (≥80% erythroid, ≥30% proerythroblasts) with vacuolated cytoplasm rather than rare giant cells in an erythroid-depleted marrow.
Tumor cells tend to form cohesive clusters with irregular nuclei, whereas this is an isolated cell with round nucleus and erythroid-type deep basophilic cytoplasm.
Megakaryoblasts may show cytoplasmic blebs but are usually smaller with scant cytoplasm and are CD61/CD42b positive rather than E-cadherin/glycophorin positive.

65339.recognize_zh: EBUS-TBNA 抹片中可見洋紅色、寬大帶狀（ribbon-like）且幾乎無分隔的真菌菌絲，呈不規則分枝並扭曲摺疊，周圍是藍染的發炎細胞，這種寬而無分隔的菌絲是毛黴菌（Mucorales）的特徵。
features: Broad, ribbon-like fungal hyphae staining magenta, with irregular width
Hyphae aseptate or pauciseptate, with irregular, wide-angle branching
Twisted and folded hyphal profiles within a dense mucoid/inflammatory aggregate
Background of numerous small inflammatory cells (bluish nuclei); no atypical epithelial cells seen
Smartphone image with color cast; fine septation cannot be fully excluded
65339.describe_en: Giemsa-stained smear from EBUS-TBNA of a lung lesion shows a dense aggregate containing numerous broad, ribbon-like, magenta-staining fungal hyphae with irregular diameter, sparse or absent septation and irregular wide-angle branching, some appearing twisted and folded. The background contains abundant small inflammatory cells without atypical epithelial cells or tumor clusters. Necrosis is not evident in this field. Findings are consistent with mucormycosis; fungal culture or molecular identification and urgent clinical correlation are recommended.

ddx.vs: Aspergillus hyphae are narrow (3 to 6 µm), uniform in width, regularly septate and branch dichotomously at acute angles.
These hyaline molds have narrow septate hyphae with acute or right-angle branching, not broad ribbon-like pauciseptate hyphae.
Mucus and fibrin lack parallel cell walls and true branching, and do not stain with GMS or calcofluor white.
Carcinoma shows cohesive atypical epithelial cells, which were absent on multiple smears here.

65083.recognize_zh: 中央濾泡的生發中心偏小、淡染，周圍套區小淋巴球排成一圈圈同心圓的「洋蔥皮」（onion skinning）樣式，濾泡間有增生的血管，這是 Castleman 病的典型結構線索。
features: Follicle with a small, pale, relatively depleted (regressed-appearing) germinal center
Expanded mantle zone with small lymphocytes arranged in concentric rings (onion-skin pattern)
Interfollicular areas with increased vascularity and scattered small vessels with plump endothelium
Additional follicles with pale germinal centers at the edge of the field; congested vascular spaces in the interfollicular region
Lymph node architecture preserved without sheets of atypical cells
65083.describe_en: Lymph node section at medium power shows preserved architecture with a follicle containing a small, pale germinal center surrounded by an expanded mantle zone in which small lymphocytes are arranged in concentric layers (onion skinning). The interfollicular region shows increased vascularity. No atypical large cell population is seen in this field. The findings are consistent with Castleman disease-type morphology; correlation with clinical criteria, plasma cell and HHV-8 (LANA-1) studies is required to classify as idiopathic multicentric Castleman disease.

ddx.vs: Morphology overlaps, but HHV-8 MCD shows LANA-1-positive plasmablasts in the mantle zone, which are absent in iMCD.
MCL expands mantles with monotonous cyclin D1+/CD5+ cells, whereas Castleman mantles are reactive, polytypic and cyclin D1-negative.
Reactive follicles have large polarized germinal centers with tingible-body macrophages and ordinary mantles, lacking concentric onion-skin layering.

ddx.dx: Follicular dendritic cell sarcoma or angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: These show atypical FDC or T-cell proliferations with clonal features, not bland concentric mantle lymphocytes.

64955.recognize_zh: 一顆大型巨噬細胞細胞質裡塞滿被吞入的細胞：上方有分葉核的嗜中性球、數顆深藍圓形核（淋巴球與有核紅血球），以及紫紅色顆粒狀的血小板與碎屑，這是骨髓抹片中典型的噬血細胞。
features: Large macrophage with abundant, granular and vacuolated cytoplasm and a large round-oval nucleus with fine chromatin
Engulfed segmented neutrophil at the upper edge of the cell
Several engulfed dense dark round nuclei consistent with lymphocytes and nucleated red cells
Pinkish-purple granular material consistent with ingested platelets and cellular debris
Adjacent granulocyte (upper left) and a plasma cell with eccentric nucleus (lower right)
64955.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large macrophage with abundant vacuolated cytoplasm containing multiple ingested hematopoietic cells, including a segmented neutrophil, dense round nuclei consistent with lymphocytes and nucleated red cells, and granular platelet material. The ingested elements are enclosed within the cytoplasm. Adjacent cells include a granulocyte and a plasma cell. In a patient with T-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma, the findings are consistent with hemophagocytosis, raising concern for lymphoma-associated hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis.

ddx.vs: Emperipolesis occurs within megakaryocytes with lobulated nuclei, and the enclosed cells remain intact rather than being digested.
Tingible body macrophages contain apoptotic nuclear debris of varying size rather than recognizable intact neutrophils, red cells and platelets.
Overlapped cells lie outside the macrophage vacuoles with separate focal planes and no surrounding phagocytic halo.
Histiocytic sarcoma shows marked nuclear atypia and pleomorphism, whereas this macrophage has a bland nucleus.

64827.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一個體積很大的巨核細胞，細胞質豐富且呈細顆粒狀、已成熟，但核卻只有單一圓形未分葉（monolobated/hypolobated），旁邊可見一團血小板；成熟細胞質配上未分葉的核即為巨核細胞發育不良的表現。
features: Very large megakaryocyte with abundant, finely granular, mature-appearing lilac cytoplasm
Single round to oval non-lobated (monolobated/hypolobated) nucleus with coarse chromatin
Nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony: mature granular cytoplasm with an unsegmented nucleus
Adjacent pink platelet aggregate near the cell border, suggesting platelet formation
Background of erythrocytes and scattered myeloid and lymphoid cells without obvious blasts
64827.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large megakaryocyte with abundant finely granular mature cytoplasm and a single round, non-lobated nucleus, with an adjacent clump of platelets suggesting platelet production. The remaining nucleated cells in the field do not show blasts. A mature megakaryocyte with a monolobated nucleus represents a dysplastic (hypolobated) form; a single cell is not diagnostic, and dysmegakaryopoiesis should be quantified (at least 10% of megakaryocytes) and correlated with blood counts and cytogenetics, particularly del(5q).

ddx.vs: Immature megakaryocytes are smaller with scant deeply basophilic agranular cytoplasm, whereas this cell has abundant mature granular cytoplasm despite a non-lobated nucleus.
Osteoclasts are multinucleated with multiple separate uniform nuclei and coarse granules, not a single large nucleus.
Micromegakaryocytes are small (near myeloblast size) with one or two small nuclei, unlike this very large cell.

ddx.dx: Metastatic tumor cell or large histiocyte
ddx.vs: Tumor cells occur in cohesive clusters with nucleoli and histiocytes show vacuoles or phagocytosed debris, whereas this cell has platelet-type granular cytoplasm and adjacent platelet budding.

64635.recognize_zh: A–C 的淋巴球有成熟染色質與淡藍細胞質，其中可見細針狀的嗜天青性包涵體，形似 Auer rod；D–F 流式顯示 CD5+/CD23+、CD200+/FMC7−、λ 輕鏈限制，確認是 CLL 而非骨髓性腫瘤。
features: Small to medium-sized lymphocytes with round nuclei and clumped, mature-appearing chromatin; a small nucleolus is faintly visible in some cells
Moderate rim of pale blue cytoplasm
Thin needle-shaped azurophilic (pink-purple) cytoplasmic inclusions resembling Auer rods
Flow panel D: CD19+ cells co-express CD5 and CD23
Flow panel E: CD19+/CD5+ cells are CD200 positive and FMC7 negative
Flow panel F: surface lambda light chain restriction (kappa negative)
64635.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (panels A–C) shows small to medium-sized mature-appearing lymphocytes with clumped chromatin and a moderate rim of pale blue cytoplasm. Several lymphocytes contain slender, needle-shaped azurophilic cytoplasmic inclusions resembling Auer rods; no blasts or myeloid features are present in these fields. Flow cytometry (panels D–F) demonstrates a CD19+ B-cell population co-expressing CD5 and CD23, positive for CD200, negative for FMC7, and lambda light chain restricted. Findings are consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia with Auer rod-like cytoplasmic inclusions.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with Auer rods
ddx.vs: True Auer rods occur in blasts with fine chromatin, nucleoli, and MPO positivity, whereas these cells are mature CD5+/CD23+ monotypic B cells.
MCL is typically CD5+ but CD23 negative/dim, CD200 negative, and FMC7 positive, with cyclin D1/SOX11 expression.

ddx.dx: B-cell lymphoproliferative disorder with crystalline immunoglobulin inclusions (e.g., lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma)
ddx.vs: LPL shows plasmacytoid differentiation and is usually CD5 and CD23 negative, unlike the CLL immunophenotype shown here.

64443.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中多顆偏心核、細胞質豐富灰藍、核周有淡染區的漿細胞，部分細胞核較大、染色質較細緻，呈未成熟外觀。背景的紅血球堆疊成錢串狀（rouleaux），提示血中有大量單株免疫球蛋白，符合多發性骨髓瘤。
features: Increased plasma cells, many with eccentric round to oval nuclei and abundant grey-blue cytoplasm
Perinuclear hof (Golgi zone) visible in several cells
Some plasma cells show enlarged nuclei with finer chromatin and relatively higher N:C ratio, suggesting immature/atypical forms; nucleoli are not sharply resolved at this focus
Occasional cell with a pale, vacuolated cytoplasmic area
Prominent rouleaux formation of red cells in the background
64443.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows increased plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, abundant grey-blue cytoplasm and perinuclear clearing. A subset display atypical features, including enlarged nuclei, finer chromatin and a higher nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio. Red cells show prominent rouleaux formation, reflecting increased serum paraprotein. Image focus limits assessment of nucleoli. Findings are consistent with a plasma cell neoplasm (multiple myeloma); quantification of plasma cells on the full aspirate and core biopsy, with light chain restriction studies, is required.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are mature, usually <10% of marrow cells, polytypic and perivascular, without nuclear immaturity or marked rouleaux.
LPL shows a spectrum of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with an IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P, rather than a predominantly plasma cell population.
Plasmablastic lymphoma cells are larger immunoblast-like cells with prominent central nucleoli, high Ki-67 and often EBER positivity, usually without an M protein.
Osteoblasts occur in clusters with the hof located away from the nucleus, and lack rouleaux-associated paraproteinemia.

64379.recognize_zh: 四格中的嗜中性球（C、D 也見單核樣細胞）細胞質內各有一到數顆小而清楚的藍綠色折光包涵體，背景紅血球多為有規則短刺的棘狀紅血球（burr cell），偶見碎裂紅血球，符合藍綠色包涵體（「綠色死亡晶體」）。
features: Neutrophils and a monocytoid cell containing one to several small, sharply defined blue-green refractile cytoplasmic inclusions
Inclusions distinct from Dohle bodies by their bright blue-green color and crisp, crystal-like outline
Leukocyte nuclei mature, segmented or band-shaped; no toxic vacuolation prominent
Numerous echinocytes (burr cells) with regular short projections in the background
Occasional fragmented red cells/schistocytes and target-like forms; platelets scarce
64379.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear, shown in four panels, demonstrates neutrophils and occasional monocytes containing small, discrete, blue-green refractile cytoplasmic inclusions. The background red cells show numerous burr cells with occasional fragmented forms, and platelets are scarce in these fields. No intracellular organisms with defined internal structure are identified. Findings are consistent with blue-green neutrophilic and monocytic inclusions, which are associated with acute liver injury, lactic acidosis and multiorgan failure and portend a poor prognosis; the clinical team should be alerted.

ddx.vs: Dohle bodies are pale gray-blue, ill-defined peripheral cytoplasmic patches rather than bright blue-green, sharply outlined refractile granules.
Morulae are mulberry-like clusters of purple granules and bacteria are rod or coccoid with a basophilic stain, not solitary glassy blue-green crystals.
MYH9 inclusions are pale blue spindle or comma shapes accompanied by giant platelets in a chronically stable patient.
Phagocytosed pigment is golden-brown and cryoglobulin appears as amorphous pale blue material, unlike discrete emerald blue-green refractile inclusions.

64315.recognize_zh: 兩顆嗜中性球的核都分成多個緊密排列的小圓葉，像葡萄串般聚在一起（botryoid nuclei），而非線狀分葉過多；背景紅血球幾乎全為皺縮棘狀細胞（echinocytes）。
features: Two neutrophils with nuclei divided into 6-8 small, round, dense lobes clustered in a rosette/grape-like pattern
Nuclear lobes are compact and centrally grouped rather than linearly connected by filaments
Cytoplasm pale lilac with fine granules; no Dohle bodies or vacuoles evident
Background of diffuse red cell crenation with numerous echinocytes
Adjacent smudged/degenerating cell and clumped platelets at right edge
64315.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two neutrophils with nuclei fragmented into multiple small, round lobes arranged in a compact, radial grape-cluster configuration. The cytoplasm shows normal fine granulation without toxic granulation or Dohle bodies. The background red cells are diffusely crenated with abundant echinocytes, and a degenerating cell with adjacent platelet clumping is present. Findings are consistent with botryoid nuclear change of neutrophils, as described in hyperthermia/heat stroke, extensive burns, and alcohol intoxication; delayed-processing artifact should be excluded clinically.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic hypersegmentation shows lobes in a linear chain joined by thin chromatin strands, often with macro-ovalocytes, not tightly clustered radial lobes.
Apoptosis produces fully separated, uniformly dense, spherical nuclear fragments in a shrunken cell with dense cytoplasm.
Aged samples show nuclear rounding and lobe separation with cytoplasmic vacuoles and echinocytes; a freshly prepared smear resolves artifactual change.

64187.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中一顆嗜酸性球，細胞質內除了一般大小的橘紅色顆粒外，還夾雜數顆明顯巨大的圓形顆粒（其中一顆接近紅血球核心大小），這種「巨大顆粒混雜正常顆粒」即是 Chediak-Higashi 症候群的線索。
features: Single eosinophil with bilobed nucleus and mature clumped chromatin
Cytoplasm contains orange-red eosinophilic granules of markedly variable size
Several giant, round, fused-appearing granules, one approaching several microns in diameter
Giant granules coexist with smaller granules of more typical size
Background red cells normocytic and normochromic with a few crenated forms; scattered platelets
64187.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a background of normocytic, normochromic red cells with occasional crenated forms. A bilobed eosinophil contains a mixture of typical orange-red granules and multiple abnormally large, round cytoplasmic granules, one strikingly giant. No Döhle-body-like inclusions or parasites are identified. Findings are consistent with the giant granules of Chediak-Higashi syndrome in an eosinophil.

ddx.vs: Pseudo-Chediak-Higashi granules occur in dysplastic or leukemic myeloid cells with blasts or dysplasia, whereas CHS granules are seen in otherwise mature leukocytes of multiple lineages in a child with albinism and infections.
Alder-Reilly granules are uniformly coarse and dark in all granulocytes, not a mixture of few giant granules among normal-sized ones.
Normal eosinophil granules are uniform in size; the discrete giant round granules here are not produced by overlap.

64123.recognize_zh: 淋巴結結構被瀰漫小淋巴球取代（A；CD20 瀰漫陽性、CD3 僅散在），壞死與顆粒球浸潤旁（B）可見核內毛玻璃狀包涵體、染色質邊緣化（margination）的細胞（C 箭頭），HSV 免疫染色在這些細胞核呈強陽性，提示 SLL 合併單純疱疹病毒淋巴結炎。
features: Low power (A): effaced nodal architecture with vague paler zones suggestive of proliferation centers
CD20: diffuse positivity of the small lymphoid infiltrate; CD3 highlights only scattered background T cells
Medium power (B): necrotic area with neutrophils and karyorrhectic debris; arrows mark enlarged cells with nuclear inclusions
High power (C): cell with glassy, eosinophilic-to-amphophilic intranuclear inclusion and marginated chromatin (Cowdry A-type), adjacent atypical cells
HSV IHC: strong nuclear (and some cytoplasmic) staining in clustered cells at the edge of necrosis
64123.describe_en: Lymph node biopsy shows effacement of the nodal architecture by a diffuse proliferation of small lymphocytes with vague paler zones, which are diffusely CD20-positive with only scattered CD3-positive T cells. Focally, there are areas of necrosis with neutrophils and karyorrhectic debris, adjacent to which are enlarged cells with glassy intranuclear inclusions and chromatin margination. An HSV immunostain highlights numerous infected nuclei at the edge of the necrotic focus. In conjunction with flow cytometry, findings are consistent with small lymphocytic lymphoma with superimposed herpes simplex virus lymphadenitis.

ddx.dx: Richter transformation (DLBCL or Hodgkin-like) in CLL/SLL
ddx.vs: Large atypical cells in Richter transformation lack viral inclusions and are HSV-negative, forming confluent sheets of large B cells or CD30+/CD15+ Hodgkin-like cells.
CMV causes cytomegaly with a single large owl-eye intranuclear inclusion plus granular cytoplasmic inclusions and is CMV IHC-positive rather than HSV-positive.
Kikuchi necrosis lacks neutrophils and viral inclusions and is rich in histiocytes and plasmacytoid dendritic cells.
VZV inclusions are morphologically identical to HSV, so separation requires virus-specific IHC or PCR.

64059.recognize_zh: 兩顆反應性淋巴球：下方大型細胞核圓、染色質較疏鬆，細胞質豐富且深藍、越往邊緣越藍（peripheral basophilia）；上方較小細胞也有中量藍色細胞質，是傳染性單核球增多症中常見的反應性 T 細胞（Downey 型）。
features: Large lymphocyte with abundant, deeply basophilic cytoplasm showing peripheral intensification of blue color
Round to slightly oval eccentric nucleus with moderately condensed but open chromatin and no distinct nucleoli
Smaller companion lymphocyte with a moderate rim of basophilic cytoplasm
Low N:C ratio in the larger cell; cytoplasm abuts adjacent red cells
Background normochromic red cells and adequate platelets; no blasts
64059.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normochromic red cells and adequate platelets. There are enlarged reactive lymphocytes with abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm that intensifies toward the periphery, round to oval nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin and no conspicuous nucleoli, and a smaller lymphocyte with a moderate rim of basophilic cytoplasm. The cells form a spectrum rather than a monotonous population, and no blasts are identified. Findings are consistent with reactive (atypical) lymphocytosis as seen in infectious mononucleosis, with serologic confirmation recommended.

ddx.vs: Blasts have high N:C ratios, fine immature chromatin and nucleoli, whereas these cells have abundant cytoplasm and more mature chromatin.
Plasma cells show eccentric clock-face nuclei with a distinct perinuclear hof rather than peripheral cytoplasmic basophilia.

ddx.dx: Leukemic large B-cell or T-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Lymphoma cells are monotonous with nuclear irregularity or nucleoli and are clonal by flow cytometry, rather than a heterogeneous spectrum of reactive cells.

ddx.dx: CMV, acute HIV or toxoplasmosis mononucleosis-like syndrome
ddx.vs: Morphology is identical, so heterophile antibody and EBV/CMV/HIV serology separate the causes.

63995.recognize_zh: 肝組織被成片的大型上皮樣單核細胞取代，細胞有豐富嗜酸性胞質、凹陷或摺疊的泡狀核與明顯核仁，夾雜多核大細胞；IHC 顯示 lysozyme 顆粒狀陽性、CD163 強陽性，Ki-67 高，符合組織球肉瘤（histiocytic sarcoma）。
features: Diffuse sheets of large epithelioid mononuclear cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm
Moderately pleomorphic oval, indented to folded nuclei with vesicular chromatin and conspicuous nucleoli
Scattered multinucleated tumor giant cells and admixed small lymphocytes/neutrophils
Lysozyme: coarse granular cytoplasmic positivity; CD163: strong membranous/cytoplasmic positivity
Ki-67: high proliferation index in the neoplastic cells
63995.describe_en: Sections of liver show hepatic parenchyma replaced by a diffuse, discohesive-to-sheetlike proliferation of large epithelioid cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm, moderately pleomorphic indented to folded nuclei, vesicular chromatin, and conspicuous nucleoli. Scattered multinucleated tumor giant cells and admixed inflammatory cells are present. The neoplastic cells show granular cytoplasmic lysozyme and strong CD163 expression, with a high Ki-67 proliferation index (approximately 60% per report). In the absence of epithelial, melanocytic, lymphoid, dendritic cell, and Langerhans cell marker expression (per report CD4, CD11c, CD33, CD68 positive), findings are consistent with histiocytic sarcoma.

ddx.dx: Anaplastic large cell lymphoma or diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Lymphomas express CD30/ALK or CD20/PAX5 and lack CD163 and lysozyme, whereas these cells are CD163+ and lysozyme+.
Langerhans cells have grooved coffee-bean nuclei and express CD1a, langerin (CD207), and S100, which histiocytic sarcoma lacks.
Carcinoma is keratin positive and melanoma is S100/SOX10/HMB45 positive, while histiocytic sarcoma is negative for these and positive for CD163.

Monocytic myeloid sarcoma cells are smaller blasts/promonocytes with MPO/CD34/CD117 or CD14 expression and usually marrow involvement, rather than large epithelioid cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm.

63931.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指紅血球顏色變淡，內含形狀不規則、呈變形蟲樣（amoeboid）的藍紫色細胞質與深紫色染色質點，並有細小粉紅色點狀斑點（Schüffner dots），這是間日瘧原蟲（P. vivax）成熟滋養體的特徵。
features: Single parasitized red cell (arrow) with pale, washed-out staining compared with neighboring cells
Irregular amoeboid blue-purple parasite cytoplasm with one or more dark purple chromatin dots
Fine pink stippling across the infected red cell consistent with Schuffner dots
Infected red cell not clearly enlarged relative to adjacent cells in this field
Background red cells without other parasites; a few tapered red cells likely from smear spreading
63931.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single parasitized red cell (arrow) in a background of largely unremarkable red cells. The infected cell is pale and contains an irregular, amoeboid trophozoite with blue-purple cytoplasm and dark chromatin, accompanied by fine pink stippling consistent with Schuffner dots. Enlargement of the infected red cell is not clearly evident in this field, and no gametocytes or schizonts are present. Findings are consistent with a mature (amoeboid) trophozoite of Plasmodium vivax; species confirmation and parasitemia should be determined on thick and thin films or by PCR or rapid antigen testing.

ddx.vs: P. ovale also shows Schuffner (James) dots but has a compact trophozoite in an oval red cell with fimbriated ragged edges rather than a spread-out amoeboid form.
P. falciparum shows small delicate ring forms, often multiple per cell with applique forms and banana-shaped gametocytes, without Schuffner dots or amoeboid mature trophozoites in peripheral blood.
P. malariae has compact band or basket trophozoites in normal-sized or small red cells without stippling (Ziemann dots only with special staining).

ddx.dx: Platelet overlying a red cell or stain precipitate
ddx.vs: An overlying platelet sits in a different focal plane with a halo and lacks a distinct chromatin dot within parasite cytoplasm and red cell stippling.

63803.recognize_zh: 大型非典型細胞呈強而一致的細胞膜與細胞質 CD30 陽性，並有核旁高基氏體區加強染色，且大細胞成串、成片聚集而非零星散在，背景小淋巴球陰性，符合灰區淋巴瘤中的 CD30 表現。
features: Large atypical cells with strong membranous and cytoplasmic CD30 staining and paranuclear (Golgi) accentuation
Vesicular nuclei, some binucleated or multilobated, with prominent nucleoli
Positive cells forming cohesive clusters, cords and near-sheets
Small background lymphocytes and spindle stromal cells negative
Diffuse fibrillary stroma separating the tumor-cell cords
63803.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD30 shows numerous large atypical cells with strong membranous and cytoplasmic staining with Golgi accentuation. The positive cells have vesicular, occasionally binucleated nuclei with nucleoli and are arranged in cohesive clusters and cords, approaching sheet-like growth, within a stroma containing negative small lymphocytes. Taken together with CD15 positivity and variable retention of CD20 and CD79a in the same cells, the findings support B-cell lymphoma with features intermediate between DLBCL and classic Hodgkin lymphoma (mediastinal gray zone lymphoma).

ddx.vs: Also has sheets of CD30+/CD15+ cells but the tumor cells lose CD20, CD79a and OCT2/BOB1 while retaining dim PAX5.
CD30 is typically weak and heterogeneous, with strong uniform CD20/CD79a and CD15 negativity.
Hallmark cells are strongly CD30 positive but PAX5 and CD20 negative, with T-cell or cytotoxic markers and often ALK.

ddx.dx: Embryonal carcinoma or other CD30-positive non-lymphoid tumor
ddx.vs: Expresses keratin, SALL4 and OCT3/4 and lacks CD45 and B-cell markers.

63675.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中箭頭所指是一顆偏小、核呈單一圓形未分葉（hypolobated / non-lobated）的巨核細胞（megakaryocyte），在造血細胞與脂肪之間，這類小型單核巨核細胞是 del(5q) 骨髓發育不良症候群的特徵線索。
features: Small megakaryocytes with round, non-lobated or hypolobated eccentric nuclei (arrow)
Megakaryocyte cytoplasm moderate, eosinophilic, with smooth contour
Cellular marrow with admixed fat spaces and dilated sinusoids
Trilineage hematopoiesis including erythroid clusters and granulocytic precursors
Scattered hemosiderin-like brown-orange pigment granules in histiocytes
No sheets of blasts appreciated at this magnification
63675.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy (H&E) shows a cellular marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis intermixed with adipocytes and dilated sinusoids. Megakaryocytes include small forms with round, non-lobated or hypolobated eccentric nuclei (arrow), a dysplastic morphology. Erythroid and granulocytic precursors are present without an obvious increase in blasts at this power, and scattered pigment-laden macrophages are seen. In the appropriate context of macrocytic anemia and a 5q deletion, findings are consistent with myelodysplastic neoplasm with isolated del(5q).

ddx.vs: MPN megakaryocytes are large to giant with hyperlobated (staghorn) or bulbous hyperchromatic nuclei, not small monolobated forms.
Micromegakaryocytes with widely separated nuclear lobes are common in other MDS, and cytogenetics showing isolated del(5q) is required to classify.
Reactive states show normally lobulated megakaryocytes of normal size without clustering of hypolobated forms.
AMKL shows sheets of immature megakaryoblasts with fibrosis and increased blasts, rather than scattered mature hypolobated megakaryocytes.

63611.recognize_zh: 一顆與紅血球大小相近的白血球，細胞內充滿粗大、深紫黑色的顆粒，顆粒多到把細胞核遮住、核輪廓幾乎看不清，這就是嗜鹼性球（basophil）。
features: Cell slightly larger than adjacent red cells
Cytoplasm packed with coarse, dark purple-black granules of variable size
Granules overlie and largely obscure an irregular, lobulated nucleus
Granules extend to and bulge the cell margin
Background of normocytic red cells and occasional platelets
63611.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single granulocyte slightly larger than surrounding red cells. The cytoplasm is filled with coarse, dark purple-black granules that overlie and obscure an irregular nucleus. Background red cells and platelets are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with a normal basophil.

ddx.vs: Mast cells are larger with a round central nucleus not obscured by granules and are found in tissue or marrow rather than peripheral blood.
Eosinophil granules are uniform, refractile and orange-pink with a clearly visible bilobed nucleus.
Toxic granules are fine and dark but sparse enough that the segmented nucleus remains clearly visible.
Platelet clumps show individual platelets with pale hyalomere at the edge rather than a single cell membrane containing granules.

63547.recognize_zh: 整個視野幾乎被中型、胞質嗜鹼性的淋巴球佔滿，細胞核圓或略凹陷、部分可見小核仁，胞質邊緣有小突起（bleb），明顯的淋巴球增多加上這種形態要想到 T-PLL。
features: Marked lymphocytosis with sheets of monomorphic medium-sized lymphoid cells
Moderately high N:C ratio with a thin rim of basophilic cytoplasm
Round to slightly indented or kidney-shaped nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin; a small nucleolus visible in some cells
Occasional cytoplasmic protrusions/blebs along the cell border
Reduced red cells in the field and a single pink granular smudge (likely platelet aggregate or smudged cell); no neutrophils present
63547.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a marked lymphocytosis composed of a monomorphic population of medium-sized lymphoid cells that outnumber other leukocytes in the field. The cells have a moderately high N:C ratio with a narrow rim of basophilic cytoplasm, round to indented nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin and, in a subset, a small visible nucleolus; several cells show small cytoplasmic blebs. No normal granulocytes are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with T-cell prolymphocytic leukemia, pending confirmation by immunophenotype and TCL1A or MTCP1 rearrangement studies.

ddx.dx: B-prolymphocytic leukemia / CLL with increased prolymphocytes
ddx.vs: B-cell prolymphocytes have a more prominent central nucleolus and paler cytoplasm, and flow shows a CD19+/CD20+ clonal B-cell population rather than CD3+ T cells.
ATLL cells have multilobated flower-shaped nuclei, are usually CD25+ and CD7-, and occur with HTLV-1 seropositivity.
Sezary cells have cerebriform grooved nuclei without nucleoli, usually CD7- and CD26-, in the setting of erythroderma.
LGL cells have abundant pale cytoplasm with azurophilic granules and are CD8+ CD57+, with lower lymphocyte counts.

63483.recognize_zh: 整片紅血球小而淡、大小形狀不一，混有許多標靶細胞（target cells）與紅血球碎片，視野中還散見數顆有核紅血球（nucleated RBC），這種組合指向重型β型海洋性貧血。
features: Marked anisopoikilocytosis with predominantly small, hypochromic red cells
Numerous target cells and scattered red cell fragments/irregular poikilocytes
Several circulating nucleated red cells with small dense pyknotic nuclei
Occasional microspherocyte-like dense cells and polychromatic cells
Scattered platelets; leukocytes are not increased in this field
63483.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked anisopoikilocytosis with a population of microcytic, hypochromic red cells. Target cells are numerous, and fragmented and irregularly shaped red cells are frequent. Multiple nucleated red blood cells are present in a single low-power field. Findings are consistent with a severe thalassemic hemoglobinopathy such as beta-thalassemia major; correlation with hemoglobin fractionation (markedly reduced or absent HbA, increased HbF) is recommended.

ddx.vs: Iron deficiency shows hypochromic microcytes with pencil cells but few target cells and no numerous circulating nucleated red cells, and the RBC count is low rather than relatively preserved.
These can look similar on the smear and are separated by hemoglobin electrophoresis/HPLC (HbE fraction, HbH inclusions on supravital stain) and globin gene testing.
Sickled (drepanocytic) cells would be present in addition to target cells, and HPLC shows HbS.
Shows a dimorphic population with Pappenheimer bodies and ring sideroblasts in the marrow rather than uniform target-rich microcytosis with many nucleated red cells.

63355.recognize_zh: 油紅 O（Oil Red O）染色下，淋巴球呈淡紫色，其邊緣的圓形包涵體依然透明、沒有紅色脂滴；紅血球呈黃綠色並有棘狀變形，證實包涵體不含脂質。
features: Small round lymphocytes with lavender hematoxylin-counterstained nuclei
Clear, unstained globular cytoplasmic inclusions at the cell periphery
No red-orange Oil Red O-positive lipid droplets in lymphocytes
Yellow-green red cells, many overlapping, with occasional crenated (echinocytic) forms
Scattered small platelets in the background
63355.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear stained with Oil Red O shows small lymphocytes, several with clear globular cytoplasmic inclusions. The inclusions do not contain red-orange Oil Red O-positive material, and no lipid droplets are seen in other cells. Red cells appear yellow-green with some crenation artifact. Findings indicate that the lymphocyte inclusions are lipid-negative.

ddx.vs: Jordans anomaly vacuoles are Oil Red O-positive and involve neutrophils and monocytes in addition to lymphocytes.
Burkitt cells are medium-sized blasts with deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing multiple small lipid-positive vacuoles.
These are Oil Red O-negative as well but are separated by PAS positivity.

63291.recognize_zh: H&E 骨髓切片中骨小樑旁的造血組織被大量中型、核染色質較開放、胞質淡的未成熟細胞取代，正常三系成熟結構不明顯，符合急性骨髓性白血病浸潤；AML-MRC 的分類需靠形態異生與細胞遺傳學判定。
features: Moderately to markedly cellular marrow between adipocytes adjacent to a bony trabecula
Diffuse infiltrate of medium-sized immature cells with round to oval nuclei, open chromatin and pale to amphophilic cytoplasm
Scattered small dark lymphoid-appearing cells and a small interstitial aggregate of small round cells
Occasional larger cells with more abundant cytoplasm; well-formed megakaryocytes are not conspicuous in this field
Interstitial hemorrhage and edematous stroma
63291.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy (H&E) shows a cellular marrow with the intertrabecular space extensively infiltrated by sheets of medium-sized immature mononuclear cells with oval nuclei, open chromatin and pale cytoplasm. Normal trilineage maturation is diminished, and well-formed megakaryocytes are not conspicuous in this field. Scattered small lymphoid cells, a small aggregate of small round cells and interstitial hemorrhage are present. Dysplastic features cannot be reliably assessed on this section alone. Findings are consistent with involvement by acute myeloid leukemia; classification as AML with myelodysplasia-related changes requires correlation with aspirate dysplasia, CD34 immunohistochemistry, cytogenetics and molecular studies.

ddx.vs: MDS-IB shows lower blast percentage with preserved, dysplastic maturation, which requires CD34 IHC and aspirate blast counts to separate from AML.
Lymphoblasts have scant cytoplasm and are TdT+/CD19+/PAX5+ and MPO-negative, which requires immunostaining to distinguish on H&E.
Regenerating marrow shows clusters of left-shifted but maturing precursors of all lineages rather than a monotonous sheet of blasts.
Metastatic tumors form cohesive nests with desmoplastic stroma and are CD45-negative with lineage-specific markers.

63227.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片細胞量很高，大量圓形、帶藍色細胞質的單核細胞密集分布於脂肪空泡之間，缺乏正常造血的多樣性；低倍下只能看出單一族群明顯增加，漿細胞的偏位核與核旁淡染區需到高倍才能確認。
features: Low-power view of a markedly cellular, particle-rich aspirate smear with numerous fat vacuoles
Dense, relatively monotonous population of round mononuclear cells with basophilic (blue) cytoplasm
Reduced apparent diversity of normal granulocytic and erythroid elements
No megakaryocytes readily identified in this field; blood-diluted area at the left edge
Individual cytologic detail (eccentric nuclei, hof, chromatin) not resolvable at this magnification
63227.describe_en: Low-power view of a Wright-Giemsa stained bone marrow aspirate smear shows a markedly cellular, particle-rich preparation with numerous fat vacuoles. The cellular trails are dominated by a relatively monotonous population of round mononuclear cells with basophilic cytoplasm, with apparent reduction of normal trilineage hematopoiesis and no megakaryocytes evident in this field. Cytologic features of individual cells cannot be assessed at this magnification. The low-power pattern is compatible with extensive marrow infiltration, which in this case was reported as mature plasma cells; high-power examination and plasma cell quantification are required to confirm multiple myeloma.

ddx.vs: At low power leukemic blasts can look similarly monotonous; high power shows fine chromatin, nucleoli and high N:C ratio rather than eccentric nuclei with clock-face chromatin and a perinuclear hof.

ddx.dx: Lymphoplasmacytic or other small B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Lymphoma infiltrates contain small cells with scant cytoplasm and a B-cell phenotype, whereas plasma cells show abundant basophilic cytoplasm and CD138/clonal light-chain restriction.
Reactive marrow retains the normal mixture of maturing granulocytes, erythroid islands and megakaryocytes instead of a monotonous population.

63099.recognize_zh: A 圖腦脊髓液中見一團核質比高、染色質細緻、細胞質布滿透明空泡的母細胞樣細胞（白血病侵犯腦膜）；B 圖則以分葉核嗜中性球為主並夾雜泡沫狀巨噬細胞，符合藥物引起的無菌性腦膜炎反應。
features: Panel A: cluster of medium-to-large mononuclear cells with high N:C ratio and molded round-to-indented nuclei
Panel A: fine chromatin and abundant, sharply punched-out clear cytoplasmic vacuoles at the cell periphery
Panel B: mixed cellularity dominated by segmented neutrophils
Panel B: vacuolated macrophages/monocytes and scattered red cells; no vacuolated blast clusters
No microorganisms visible in either panel
63099.describe_en: Two cytospin preparations of cerebrospinal fluid are shown. Panel A shows a cohesive-appearing cluster of immature mononuclear cells with high N:C ratios, fine chromatin and prominent peripheral cytoplasmic vacuoles, consistent with CSF involvement by the patient's known lymphoblastic leukemia. Panel B shows a neutrophil-predominant pleocytosis with admixed vacuolated macrophages and red cells, without an evident blast population or organisms. In the clinical setting, panel B supports a drug-induced aseptic meningitis superimposed on prior meningeal leukemia; microbiologic cultures are required to exclude infection.

ddx.vs: Also neutrophil-predominant, but shows organisms on Gram stain/culture with low glucose, whereas drug-induced aseptic meningitis is culture-negative.
Macrophages have lower N:C ratio, reniform nuclei, abundant gray-blue cytoplasm and phagocytosed debris, unlike the high N:C blasts of panel A.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with vacuoles and a mature B (CD10+, TdT-negative, sIg+) phenotype, versus TdT+ Ph-positive B-lymphoblasts.
Peripheral blood contamination yields leukocytes proportional to red cells, not a disproportionate neutrophilic pleocytosis.

63035.recognize_zh: 視野中央一個大型前紅血球母細胞，體積約為旁邊嗜中性球的兩倍，細胞質是一圈深藍色、核圓且染色質細緻淡染；在 Parvovirus 感染的情境下，這種巨大前紅血球母細胞（giant pronormoblast）是典型線索，但此圖解析度下看不到明確的核內包涵體。
features: Giant pronormoblast roughly twice the diameter of the adjacent neutrophil
Round nucleus with finely granular, pale chromatin filling most of the cell; nucleoli not clearly resolved
Narrow rim of intensely basophilic, deep-blue agranular cytoplasm
Adjacent band/segmented neutrophil with normal granulation for size comparison
Background red cells normocytic with scattered platelets; discrete intranuclear inclusion not resolved at this magnification
63035.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a markedly enlarged pronormoblast, approximately twice the size of an adjacent neutrophil, with a round nucleus containing finely dispersed pale chromatin and a narrow rim of intensely basophilic agranular cytoplasm. A distinct viral intranuclear inclusion or cytoplasmic vacuolation is not clearly resolved at this magnification, and the surrounding field lacks maturing erythroid precursors. In the clinical context, findings are consistent with a giant pronormoblast of parvovirus B19 infection; correlation with reticulocytopenia and parvovirus PCR is recommended.

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts have less basophilic cytoplasm, visible nucleoli and may contain granules or Auer rods, and are CD34/MPO positive rather than E-cadherin/CD71 positive.
Pure erythroid leukemia shows sheets of proerythroblasts with cytoplasmic vacuoles and dysplasia, whereas parvovirus giant pronormoblasts are isolated in an otherwise erythroid-depleted marrow.
Plasmablasts have eccentric nuclei with a perinuclear hof and a prominent central nucleolus, and are CD138 positive.

62971.recognize_zh: 低倍下有核細胞極多，幾乎全是各成熟階段的粒細胞系（前髓細胞、髓細胞、後髓細胞、帶狀及分節嗜中性球），以髓細胞為主峰，母細胞不多，並可見嗜鹼性球；這種「髓細胞高峰、無母細胞增加」的全階段粒細胞增生，是慢性骨髓性白血病慢性期（CML-CP）的典型樣貌。
features: Markedly increased granulocytic cells spanning all stages of maturation
Myelocytes and metamyelocytes predominate (myelocyte peak), with numerous bands and segmented neutrophils
Occasional basophils and eosinophils present
Blasts not increased; few scattered cells with finer chromatin only
Erythroid precursors relatively sparse (increased M:E ratio)
62971.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (Wright-Giemsa, low power) is markedly cellular and dominated by granulocytic cells at all stages of maturation, with a predominance of myelocytes and metamyelocytes and numerous bands and segmented neutrophils. Scattered basophils and eosinophils are present, erythroid precursors are relatively reduced, and blasts do not appear increased. Megakaryocytes are not assessable in this field. Findings are consistent with chronic myeloid leukemia, BCR::ABL1-positive, in chronic phase, as confirmed by FISH and PCR.

ddx.vs: Reactive states show a peak of segmented neutrophils and bands with toxic granulation and Döhle bodies, without basophilia or a myelocyte peak, and are BCR::ABL1-negative.
aCML has prominent granulocytic dysplasia (hypogranular, pseudo-Pelger neutrophils) without significant basophilia and lacks BCR::ABL1, often with SETBP1/ASXL1 mutations.
CNL shows mature segmented neutrophils making up at least 80% of WBC with immature granulocytes under 10%, and CSF3R mutation rather than a myelocyte peak.
Advanced phases show increased blasts (10-19% or at least 20%), basophils at least 20%, or blast clusters, which are not seen here.

62907.recognize_zh: 兩個嗜中性球的細胞質內可見粗大、深紫黑色的顆粒團，上方細胞同時有清楚的細胞質空泡（vacuolation），下方細胞為分葉核、黑色顆粒集中在細胞周邊；空泡加上異常黑色顆粒，對應敗血症毒性變化與造影劑相關色素。
features: Two neutrophils with lobulated nuclei
Coarse dark purple-black granular clumps in the cytoplasm, peripheral in the lower cell and perinuclear in the upper cell
Distinct clear cytoplasmic vacuoles in the upper neutrophil
Background of normochromic red cells with several echinocytes
Occasional platelets; no organisms seen
62907.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two neutrophils with lobulated nuclei containing coarse, dark purple-black cytoplasmic granular aggregates; the upper cell additionally shows several clear cytoplasmic vacuoles. Red cells are normochromic with scattered echinocytes, and platelets are present. No intracellular microorganisms are identified. In a septic patient sampled after iodinated contrast, findings are consistent with pigment in neutrophils accompanied by toxic changes (vacuolation and toxic granulation).

ddx.vs: Toxic granules are finer and evenly distributed, without irregular black clumps.
Bacteria appear as discrete uniform cocci or rods, often within vacuoles, rather than amorphous black granules.
Shows lipid vacuoles in most neutrophils without dark granular pigment.

62843.recognize_zh: CD71 染色下只有少數散在、小群的紅血球系前驅細胞呈棕色膜狀陽性，其餘大量細胞為陰性，表示紅血球生成明顯減少，是骨髓被漿細胞與顆粒球系細胞擠壓的背景變化。
features: IHC for CD71 (transferrin receptor) on a hypercellular marrow core
Only sparse CD71-positive cells with membranous/cytoplasmic brown staining, singly and in small clusters of 2–5 cells
Positive cells are small-to-intermediate with round nuclei, consistent with erythroid precursors
No large erythroid islands or sheets of CD71-positive cells
Vast majority of the cellular population is CD71 negative
62843.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD71 on the bone marrow trephine highlights only sparse erythroid precursors, present singly and in small clusters, without well-formed erythroid islands. The dense background population, comprising granulocytic cells and the plasma cell infiltrate, is CD71 negative. Findings indicate markedly reduced erythropoiesis in a hypercellular marrow, a pattern that can contribute to anemia in plasma cell myeloma.

ddx.vs: PRCA shows near-absent erythroid precursors in an otherwise normocellular marrow without a clonal plasma cell infiltrate or myeloid expansion.
Pure erythroid leukemia shows sheets of CD71-positive immature erythroid cells, the opposite of the sparse staining here.
Erythroid precursors may be reduced but the marrow is not replaced by clusters of CD138-positive, light chain-restricted plasma cells.

62779.recognize_zh: 周邊血中兩顆大型淋巴球胞質豐富、充滿粗大的紫紅色顆粒與包涵體，流式顯示 CD3+CD8+CD57+CD16+ 並表現 CD94/NKG2A，骨髓 CD8、granzyme B、TIA1 染色呈竇內線狀排列，符合 T 細胞大顆粒淋巴球白血病。
features: Large lymphocytes with round to slightly indented nuclei and condensed chromatin
Abundant cytoplasm packed with coarse azurophilic granules and large granular inclusions
Flow cytometry: CD3+ CD16+ CD8+ CD57+ T cells with dim CD5 and CD94/NKG2A expression; CD158a/b (KIR) negative
Bone marrow IHC: CD8, granzyme B, and TIA1 positive cells in interstitial and intrasinusoidal linear arrays
Red cells show mild anisocytosis without schistocytes
62779.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows large lymphocytes with mature condensed chromatin and abundant cytoplasm containing coarse azurophilic granules and larger granular cytoplasmic inclusions; image resolution limits detailed characterization of the inclusions. Flow cytometry identifies an expanded CD3+ CD8+ CD57+ CD16+ T-cell population with dim CD5 and CD94/NKG2A expression and absent CD158a/b. Bone marrow biopsy immunostains for CD8, granzyme B, and TIA1 highlight an interstitial and intrasinusoidal linear infiltrate of cytotoxic lymphocytes. Findings are consistent with T-cell large granular lymphocytic leukemia; STAT3 mutation analysis and TCR clonality studies would support the diagnosis.

ddx.dx: Reactive expansion of large granular lymphocytes (e.g., viral infection, post-transplant)
ddx.vs: Reactive LGL expansions are transient and polyclonal by TCR studies, lack aberrant antigen loss, and do not form intrasinusoidal linear marrow clusters.

ddx.dx: Chronic lymphoproliferative disorder of NK cells
ddx.vs: NK-cell LGL proliferations are surface CD3-negative with restricted KIR expression, whereas these cells are CD3-positive cytotoxic T cells.
Aggressive NK-cell leukemia shows atypical cells with immature chromatin and nucleoli, CD3-negative/CD56-positive EBV-positive phenotype, and a fulminant clinical course.
Chediak-Higashi syndrome shows giant granules in neutrophils and other granulocytes in a child with albinism, rather than inclusions restricted to a clonal CD8+ T-cell population.

62779.stain: Wright-Giemsa; flow cytometry; IHC: CD8, granzyme B, TIA1

62715.recognize_zh: 這是流式 CD45 對側向散射（SS）圖：絕大部分事件落在 CD45 弱陽性、低 SS 的「原始細胞區」（Blasts 93.69%），正常顆粒球（0.93%）、單核球（0.06%）與淋巴球（2.13%）幾乎被取代，代表檢體被原始細胞大量浸潤。
features: CD45 versus side scatter plot of live events
Dominant population with dim CD45 and low side scatter in the blast gate, 93.69% of live events
Markedly reduced granulocytes (0.93%) in the high side scatter region
Near absence of monocytes (0.06%) and few lymphocytes (2.13%) with bright CD45
Blast cluster shows a continuous tail toward brighter CD45 and slightly higher side scatter
62715.describe_en: Flow cytometric CD45 versus side scatter analysis of live events shows a dominant population with dim CD45 and low side scatter occupying the blast gate, accounting for 93.69% of events. Normal populations are markedly reduced, with granulocytes 0.93%, monocytes 0.06% and lymphocytes 2.13%. This pattern indicates near-complete replacement by blasts but does not define lineage, which requires the subsequent B-cell and myeloid marker analysis. In context, the findings support acute leukemia, subsequently characterized as mixed phenotype acute leukemia, B/myeloid.

ddx.vs: Hematogones occupy a similar CD45-dim/low SS region but show a continuous maturation spectrum (CD34/CD10/CD20/CD45) without a discrete aberrant population and rarely exceed a minority of events.
Neoplastic mature lymphocytes are CD45 bright in the lymphocyte gate rather than CD45 dim in the blast gate.
These cells are typically CD45 negative, falling left of the blast gate, and lack blast-associated markers.

62587.recognize_zh: 低倍下淋巴結被密集、單調的淋巴細胞取代，可見邊界模糊的擴大結節由纖維血管帶分隔，缺乏正常濾泡的套區與極性；此放大倍率無法計數中心母細胞（centroblast），分級需高倍評估。
features: Effaced architecture with crowded, vaguely nodular aggregates of lymphoid cells
Nodules lack distinct mantle zones and polarization; tingible-body macrophages are not conspicuous
Mixed small cleaved and larger cells; individual centroblasts cannot be reliably counted at this magnification
Internodular fibrovascular septa with scattered interfollicular small lymphocytes
No necrosis or sheets of confluent large cells in the field shown
62587.describe_en: Sections of lymph node show effacement of the normal architecture by a dense lymphoid proliferation arranged in closely packed, ill-defined nodules separated by thin fibrovascular septa. The nodules lack well-formed mantle zones and zonation, and tingible-body macrophages are not prominent. At this intermediate magnification the neoplastic population appears to include both small cleaved cells and larger cells, but centroblasts per high-power field cannot be enumerated from this image. No diffuse sheets of large cells are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with follicular lymphoma; grading (grade 3A) requires high-power centroblast counts.

ddx.vs: Reactive follicles are polarized with intact mantle zones, abundant tingible-body macrophages and BCL2-negative germinal centers, unlike these crowded back-to-back nodules.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma arising in FL
ddx.vs: DLBCL shows diffuse sheets of large cells replacing nodules, whereas this field retains a nodular pattern.

ddx.dx: Nodal marginal zone lymphoma with follicular colonization
ddx.vs: MZL shows monocytoid cells with pale cytoplasm around residual follicles and is CD10/BCL6-negative in the neoplastic cells.
MCL is monotonous without centroblasts and expresses cyclin D1 and SOX11.

62523.recognize_zh: 高倍下大部分為無結構、細顆粒並有空泡的壞死物質，中間夾雜波浪狀膠原纖維與少數退化細胞核；這是壞死性肉芽腫的中心區，單看此區無法確認病因，需配合周邊柵欄狀組織球與銀染色。
features: Amorphous, finely granular and vacuolated eosinophilic necrotic material
Wavy bundles of residual collagen within the necrotic zone
Scattered degenerated, smudged nuclei and nuclear debris
No viable granulomatous rim, giant cells or organisms visible in this field
62523.describe_en: High-power H&E shows predominantly amorphous, finely granular and vacuolated necrotic material containing wavy residual collagen bundles and scattered degenerated nuclei and nuclear debris. No viable epithelioid histiocytes, giant cells or organisms are identified in this field. The appearance represents the central necrotic zone of a necrotizing granulomatous process; in isolation it is nonspecific, and correlation with the palisading histiocytic rim, special stains for organisms and clinical history is needed to support cat scratch disease.

ddx.vs: Caseous necrosis is more homogeneous without neutrophilic debris, and acid-fast stains or cultures identify mycobacteria.
Ghost outlines of large atypical cells and viable lymphoma at the periphery, confirmed by IHC, favor necrotic lymphoma.
Kikuchi shows karyorrhectic necrosis with abundant crescentic histiocytes and no neutrophils.

62459.recognize_zh: gate 在 CD3 T 細胞的 CD4 對 SSC 流式圖：CD4 gate 佔 CD3 細胞 99.76%，幾乎所有 T 細胞都是 CD4 陽性，但大部分 CD4 表現偏弱（藍色），只有 7.06% 位於正常 CD4 亮度的 gate A（綠色），顯示 CD4 dim 的異常 T 細胞大量擴增。
features: Dot plot of side scatter (SS INT) versus CD4-FITC gated on CD3-positive T cells
CD4 gate contains 99.76% of CD3 T cells (56.89% of total), indicating near-absent CD8 T cells
Most CD4 T cells (blue) show dim, broadly spread CD4 intensity below the normal range
Gate A (green) at normal CD4 intensity contains only 7.06% of gated T cells (residual normal CD4 T cells)
Low side scatter throughout; non-morphologic figure
62459.describe_en: Flow cytometric plot of side scatter versus CD4 on CD3-gated T cells shows that 99.76% of T cells fall within the CD4 gate, indicating a marked CD4 predominance with virtually absent CD8 T cells. Most of these cells express CD4 at dim intensity, with only 7.06% of T cells located in gate A at normal CD4 brightness. The expanded CD4-dim population correlates with the CD7-negative and CD26-negative population in companion plots. Findings are consistent with a markedly elevated CD4:CD8 ratio and an aberrant CD4-dim T-cell population, supporting peripheral blood involvement by Sezary cells.

ddx.vs: Normal T cells show about 60-70% CD4 and 30-40% CD8 with uniform bright CD4, unlike the near-exclusive CD4-dim population here.
Monocytes are CD4 dim but CD3 negative with higher side scatter, so they would be excluded by the CD3 gate.
ATLL also shows a CD4-predominant aberrant T-cell population but is CD25 bright and HTLV-1 positive.

62395.recognize_zh: 六格組圖中，骨髓抹片與切片的巨噬細胞內塞滿大量 2–4 µm 的小型卵圓酵母菌，外圍有透明暈；PAS 染成洋紅色、GMS 染成黑色的細胞內小酵母，是組織胞漿菌症（histoplasmosis）的特徵，周邊血則見嗜中性球毒性變化。
features: Panel A (PB): neutrophil with toxic changes (vacuolation) among normocytic red cells
Panel B (BM aspirate): macrophages containing numerous small intracellular oval yeasts with clear halos
Panels C-D (H&E): histiocytes distended by clusters of 2-4 micron yeasts with pericellular clearing
Panel E (PAS): magenta-staining small yeasts within histiocytes
Panel F (GMS): black-staining uniform small yeasts, some with narrow-based budding
Background marrow with mixed hematopoietic and inflammatory cells, no well-formed granulomas visible
62395.describe_en: Composite figure shows a peripheral blood smear with a neutrophil exhibiting toxic vacuolation (A). The bone marrow aspirate contains macrophages filled with numerous small, uniform intracellular yeast forms with surrounding clear halos (B). Corresponding H&E sections show histiocytes distended by clusters of 2-4 micron yeasts (C, D), which are highlighted by PAS (E) and Gomori methenamine silver (F) stains, with occasional narrow-based budding. Well-formed granulomas are not evident in these panels. Findings are consistent with disseminated histoplasmosis involving the bone marrow, supported by positive urine and serum Histoplasma antigen.

ddx.vs: Leishmania amastigotes contain a rod-shaped kinetoplast and are PAS- and GMS-negative, unlike Histoplasma yeasts.
Talaromyces yeasts divide by fission with a central transverse septum and are often sausage-shaped rather than budding.
C. glabrata yeasts are slightly larger, less uniformly intracellular, and grow readily on routine culture.
Toxoplasma tachyzoites are GMS-negative, and Pneumocystis cysts are extracellular cup-shaped forms rather than intra-histiocytic budding yeasts.

62203.recognize_zh: 視野中幾乎全是小至中型的淋巴球，圓核、染色質粗塊、細胞質呈窄邊淡藍，部分細胞較大、核染色質較細並可見小核仁（前淋巴球），下方有一個破碎的塗抹細胞，符合 CLL 伴前淋巴球。
features: Monotonous population of small to medium lymphocytes with round nuclei and clumped chromatin
Scant rim of pale-blue cytoplasm in most cells
Subset of larger cells with less condensed chromatin and occasional small nucleoli (prolymphocytes)
Smudge (basket) cell at the bottom and a ruptured cell at the lower right
Platelet clumps scattered in the background
62203.describe_en: The smear shows a monotonous population of small to medium lymphocytes with round nuclei, coarse clumped chromatin, and scant pale-blue cytoplasm. A proportion of larger cells shows less condensed chromatin and small nucleoli, consistent with prolymphocytes, and smudge cells are present. Scattered platelet clumps are noted. Findings are consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia with increased prolymphocytes.

ddx.vs: Leukemic mantle cell lymphoma shows more irregular nuclei and a CD5+/CD23-negative, cyclin D1-positive phenotype, unlike CD23-positive CLL.
B-PLL is dominated (>55%) by medium cells with a single prominent nucleolus and is CD23-negative and FMC7/CD20-bright, whereas here small clumped-chromatin cells predominate.
Splenic marginal zone lymphoma cells often have polar villous projections and are usually CD5- and CD23-negative.

62139.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中可見一團緊密黏聚（cohesive）的中型異常細胞，核圓、染色質細緻、胞質少而淡藍，與周圍散在造血細胞不同，提示非造血性轉移腫瘤（此例為肺泡型橫紋肌肉瘤）。
features: Cohesive cluster of medium-sized malignant cells with nuclear molding
Round nuclei with finely granular chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli
Scant to moderate pale basophilic cytoplasm, with a few small vacuoles
Separate small clusters of similar atypical cells at left
Hemodilute background; red cells show refractile drying artifact
62139.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a hemodilute background in which a cohesive cluster of medium-sized atypical cells is present, with additional small groups of similar cells nearby. The cells have round nuclei with finely granular chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli, and scant pale blue cytoplasm with occasional small vacuoles. The dot-like red cell inclusions are consistent with drying artifact. The cohesive clustering favors a non-hematopoietic small round cell tumor; in this clinical context the findings are consistent with marrow involvement by alveolar rhabdomyosarcoma, to be confirmed by biopsy with myogenin/desmin immunohistochemistry.

ddx.vs: Leukemic blasts are dispersed as single cells without cohesive clusters and express TdT/CD34/CD19, whereas rhabdomyosarcoma is desmin and myogenin positive.
Neuroblastoma forms rosettes with fibrillary neuropil and is PHOX2B/synaptophysin positive, lacking myogenic markers.
Ewing sarcoma cells often have PAS-positive glycogen vacuoles and strong membranous CD99 with NKX2.2 and EWSR1 rearrangement, rather than PAX3/7::FOXO1 fusions.
Burkitt cells are discohesive with deeply basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm and express CD20/CD10 with MYC rearrangement.

62075.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中有一團緊密黏合、互相擠壓的大型細胞，核圓且有細顆粒染色質與小核仁，細胞質深藍並含多個小空泡，與周圍分散的血球明顯不同，提示轉移性腫瘤細胞群。
features: Tight cohesive cluster of large cells distinct from surrounding dispersed hematopoietic elements
High N:C ratio with round nuclei showing nuclear crowding and molding
Finely granular chromatin with small nucleoli in some cells
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing multiple small clear vacuoles
Background shows mainly smeared red cells and few nucleated cells; overall marrow cellularity cannot be judged from this single field
62075.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a tight, cohesive three-dimensional cluster of large cells that stands out from the dispersed background elements. The cells have high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, round crowded nuclei with focal molding, finely granular chromatin with small nucleoli, and deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing multiple small vacuoles. The background contains mostly red cells with few hematopoietic cells, although overall cellularity should be assessed on the biopsy. Findings are consistent with a metastatic non-hematopoietic tumor cell cluster; the primary site requires correlation with the core biopsy and immunohistochemistry.

ddx.vs: Burkitt cells also have basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm but are discohesive single cells rather than a molded cohesive cluster, and are CD20/CD10-positive.
Osteoblasts have eccentric nuclei with a pale cytoplasmic hof away from the nucleus and lie in loose groups rather than crowded molded clusters with vacuoles.

ddx.dx: Clumped acute leukemia blasts or plasma cells
ddx.vs: Aggregated blasts or plasma cells lack true cohesion and nuclear molding, and are identified by flow cytometry markers (CD45, CD34, CD138) rather than keratin or neuroendocrine markers.

62011.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中細胞偏多，除了成群的紅血球系前驅細胞外，可見體積小、核分葉不良的巨核細胞（hypolobated micromegakaryocyte，左下方）；小而少分葉的巨核細胞加上三系混雜，是 MDS 巨核細胞發育不良的切片線索。
features: Hypercellular marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis between fat spaces
Small megakaryocytes with hypolobated or monolobated round nuclei
Clusters of erythroid precursors with round dark nuclei
Admixed maturing granulocytes
No sheets of blasts; interstitial hemorrhage present
62011.describe_en: H&E section of the bone marrow core biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis. Megakaryocytes include small forms with hypolobated, round nuclei, suggestive of dysmegakaryopoiesis. Erythroid precursors form clusters and granulocytic maturation is present. No sheets of blasts are identified. The findings are compatible with a myelodysplastic neoplasm with multilineage dysplasia, in keeping with MDS with ring sideroblasts and multilineage dysplasia in the referenced case.

ddx.vs: Del(5q) shows numerous non-lobated/hypolobated megakaryocytes typically of normal to large size and requires cytogenetic confirmation; ring sideroblasts and SF3B1 mutation favor MDS-RS.
MDS/MPN-RS-T has large, hyperlobated MPN-like megakaryocytes with thrombocytosis rather than small hypolobated forms.
Reactive megakaryocytes are normally lobated and well dispersed without micromegakaryocytes.

61947.recognize_zh: CD5染色下，濾泡間區有大量強膜狀陽性的T細胞，中央一個圓形區域（殘存濾泡）染色較淡、只散在少數陽性T細胞，說明結構仍保留、T細胞在濾泡間擴張，符合反應性變化。
features: Numerous CD5-positive small T cells with strong membranous staining in the interfollicular zone
Central rounded area with weak background staining and only scattered positive T cells, consistent with a residual follicle
Preserved compartmentalization of T-cell zones and B-cell follicle
No sheets of CD5-positive large atypical cells
61947.describe_en: Low-to-medium power CD5 immunostain highlights abundant T cells with strong membranous staining in expanded interfollicular zones. A rounded follicle-like area in the center contains only scattered CD5-positive T cells within a weakly stained B-cell compartment. The preserved follicular/interfollicular compartmentalization and absence of aberrant CD5 loss favor a reactive T-cell expansion, as seen in EBV reactivation.

ddx.vs: In these CD5+ B-cell neoplasms the positive cells co-express CD20 and form nodules or diffuse sheets (with cyclin D1 or LEF1), rather than being T cells in the interfollicular zone.
PTCL often shows aberrant loss of CD5 or CD7 in atypical T cells, whereas here CD5 is retained in a reactive-appearing T-cell population.
AITL effaces follicles and shows TFH marker expression with expanded FDC meshworks, whereas a residual follicle is preserved here.

61819.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中一顆嗜中性球核分成兩大葉，葉間有兩個小核碎片（nuclear projections），細胞質顆粒偏少，屬於核分葉異常的發育不良嗜中性球；背景紅血球有輕度大小不一與橢圓形紅血球。
features: Neutrophil with two main nuclear lobes and small detached nuclear fragments between them
Coarsely clumped nuclear chromatin
Pale cytoplasm with reduced, sparse granulation
Background red cells with mild anisocytosis and scattered ovalocytes
Platelets not conspicuous in this field
61819.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a neutrophil with abnormal nuclear segmentation, comprising two main lobes with small detached nuclear fragments between them, coarse chromatin and reduced cytoplasmic granulation.
