ddx.vs: This entity shows ring sideroblasts on iron stain and dyserythropoiesis in addition to ET-like megakaryocytes.

1211.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中細胞核卵圓或腎形、彼此之間被淡染透明胞質隔開、間距均勻（像煎蛋 fried-egg 樣），並在浸潤區間夾雜外滲紅血球湖；這種間隔分明的間質性浸潤是毛狀細胞白血病（HCL）在切片上的典型表現。
features: Diffuse interstitial infiltrate of small to medium mononuclear cells with evenly spaced nuclei
Oval, reniform or indented nuclei with bland, finely stippled chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli
Abundant pale to clear cytoplasm creating a fried-egg appearance with distinct cell separation
Extravasated red cells forming small blood lakes between cells
Residual fat cells; few normal hematopoietic elements in the infiltrated area
1211.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows an interstitial to diffuse infiltrate of small to medium mononuclear cells with oval, reniform or indented nuclei, bland chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and abundant pale cytoplasm that keeps the nuclei widely and evenly spaced, imparting a fried-egg appearance. Extravasated red cells form small blood lakes within the infiltrate, and residual normal hematopoiesis is reduced. Mitotic activity is not conspicuous. Findings are consistent with involvement by hairy cell leukemia, which should be confirmed by immunohistochemistry for CD20, annexin A1, cyclin D1 and BRAF V600E, with reticulin stain to document the typical fibrosis responsible for a dry tap.

ddx.vs: Mast cell infiltrates are paratrabecular or perivascular aggregates of spindled cells with fibrosis and eosinophils, and are tryptase/CD117 positive rather than CD20/annexin A1 positive.
SMZL typically forms intrasinusoidal and nodular infiltrates of cells with less abundant cytoplasm and is annexin A1 and BRAF V600E negative.
These lack the monotonous evenly spaced lymphoid infiltrate, and hematopoietic cells are simply reduced with CD20-negative interstitium.
Monocytic cells also have reniform nuclei but show higher-grade chromatin, mitoses and lysozyme/CD68/CD163 positivity instead of B-cell markers.

1275.recognize_zh: 低倍下周邊血液淋巴球明顯增多，細胞中小型、大小相當一致，核圓或略不規則，胞質少量且偏深藍，部分有小突起，並散在幾個塗抹細胞（smudge cells）；單調的嗜鹼性胞質淋巴球增多是 T-PLL 的低倍印象，細節需高倍與流式確認。
features: Marked lymphocytosis of fairly monotonous small to medium-sized lymphoid cells
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with condensed chromatin
Scant, deeply basophilic cytoplasm, some cells with small cytoplasmic blebs
Occasional smudge cells
Nucleoli and nuclear contour detail not reliably assessable at this magnification
1275.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low power shows a marked lymphocytosis composed of fairly monotonous small to medium-sized lymphoid cells with round to slightly irregular nuclei, condensed chromatin and scant deeply basophilic cytoplasm, some with small cytoplasmic blebs. Occasional smudge cells are present, and red cells appear unremarkable. Nucleoli and nuclear irregularities cannot be reliably evaluated at this magnification. Findings are suggestive of a mature T-cell leukemia such as T-cell prolymphocytic leukemia, which requires flow cytometric and cytogenetic (TCL1A) confirmation.

ddx.vs: CLL cells are small with clumped soccer-ball chromatin and scant pale cytoplasm, and are CD5/CD23-positive B cells, whereas T-PLL is a TCL1A-rearranged T-cell leukemia.
LGL cells have abundant pale cytoplasm with azurophilic granules and a modest count, rather than scant basophilic agranular cytoplasm.
MCL cells have irregular nuclei and similar size but are CD5+ B cells with cyclin D1/SOX11 expression.

1083.recognize_zh: 周邊血白血球大量增加，從骨髓母細胞、前骨髓細胞、骨髓細胞、後骨髓細胞到分節中性球都看得到（完整左移），並可見嗜鹼性球，這是慢性期 CML 的經典抹片。
features: Marked leukocytosis with the full spectrum of granulocytic maturation
Numerous myelocytes and metamyelocytes alongside bands and segmented neutrophils
Occasional larger immature cells (promyelocytes/rare blasts)
Basophils with dark coarse granules present
No dysplasia; red cells normocytic with platelets present
1083.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked leukocytosis composed of granulocytes at all stages of maturation, with prominent myelocytes and metamyelocytes, numerous bands and segmented neutrophils, and occasional promyelocytes and rare blasts. Basophils are present. Granulocytes lack significant dysplasia and monocytes are not increased. Findings are consistent with chronic myeloid leukemia, chronic phase; confirmation by BCR::ABL1 testing is required.

ddx.vs: Leukemoid reactions show toxic granulation and Döhle bodies, lack basophilia, and have high LAP score without BCR::ABL1.
aCML shows prominent granulocytic dysplasia (hypogranular, pseudo-Pelger) without basophilia and lacks BCR::ABL1.
CNL consists mainly of mature segmented neutrophils with <10% immature granulocytes and CSF3R mutation.
CMML has absolute monocytosis ≥10% of leukocytes and fewer circulating immature granulocytes.

1147.recognize_zh: 低倍淋巴結切片可見大片嗜酸性壞死區，其中散布核碎片（karyorrhexis）與發炎細胞，周邊有血管與脂肪空泡；此倍率看不到病毒包涵體，僅能看出壞死性淋巴結炎。
features: Extensive geographic eosinophilic necrosis with fibrinous appearance
Abundant scattered nuclear debris (karyorrhexis) and inflammatory cells within necrosis
Denser cellular area toward one side with mixed small cells
Blood vessels and round fat vacuoles within the tissue
Viral inclusions not resolvable at this magnification
1147.describe_en: Lymph node section at low to medium power shows extensive eosinophilic necrosis with abundant karyorrhectic nuclear debris and scattered inflammatory cells. A more cellular area is present along one side, and vessels and fat vacuoles are seen within the tissue. Viral cytopathic changes cannot be evaluated at this magnification. Findings are those of a necrotizing lymphadenitis; in context, herpes simplex virus lymphadenitis is favored, pending higher-power review for intranuclear inclusions and HSV immunohistochemistry.

ddx.vs: Kikuchi necrosis lacks neutrophils and viral inclusions and is rimmed by crescentic histiocytes, with negative HSV immunostaining.
Lupus shows hematoxylin bodies and Azzopardi phenomenon with vasculitis, and serologic evidence of SLE.
Ghost outlines of large atypical cells in necrosis and viable lymphoma at the edge, confirmed by IHC, indicate lymphoma rather than infection.

4219.recognize_zh: 低倍免疫染色顯示真皮淺中層多處血管周圍陽性淋巴球團，並有陽性細胞沿表皮基底層分布，呈 T 細胞表皮向性浸潤的分布型態，符合 ATLL 皮膚侵犯。
features: Multiple discrete superficial and mid-dermal perivascular clusters of immunoreactive lymphoid cells
Scattered positive cells along the dermoepidermal junction and within the basal epidermis
Deeper dermis contains only sparse single positive cells
Epidermis itself is negative
Low magnification precludes assessment of cytology
4219.describe_en: Low-power immunohistochemical stain of skin (specific marker not labeled) highlights multiple perivascular lymphoid aggregates in the superficial and mid dermis, with scattered positive cells at the dermoepidermal junction and within the basal epidermis. The deep dermis contains only sparse positive cells, and the epidermis is otherwise negative. The distribution indicates a perivascular and epidermotropic T-cell infiltrate, consistent with cutaneous involvement by adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma in the appropriate clinical and serologic context.

ddx.vs: The epidermotropic perivascular pattern overlaps; HTLV-1 serology and diffuse CD25 expression favor ATLL.
T-PLL tends to form perivascular/periadnexal dermal infiltrates with less epidermotropism and is TCL1-positive.
Reactive T cells are small, polyclonal, and not accompanied by aberrant antigen loss or HTLV-1 infection.

4091.recognize_zh: 免疫染色中成片的大型腫瘤細胞呈強膜狀與核旁點狀（Golgi）陽性，細胞核大、不規則，背景小淋巴球陰性，典型 CD30 型態；需確認 B 細胞標記才能診斷間變型 DLBCL 而非 ALCL。
features: Numerous large atypical cells with enlarged irregular nuclei and abundant cytoplasm
Strong membranous staining with paranuclear Golgi-dot accentuation
Positive cells arranged in cohesive sheets and cords, partly between vascular/stromal strands
Background small lymphocytes negative
Occasional cell with strong cytoplasmic blush (likely histiocytic/granular staining)
4091.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain (marker not labeled; membrane and Golgi pattern typical of CD30) shows numerous large atypical cells with irregular vesicular nuclei arranged in cohesive sheets and cords, exhibiting strong membranous and paranuclear dot-like staining. Background small lymphocytes are negative. Findings demonstrate strong CD30 expression in a large cell lymphoma, as expected in the anaplastic variant of diffuse large B-cell lymphoma; B-cell lineage confirmation and ALK staining are required to exclude ALK-positive or ALK-negative anaplastic large cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: ALCL shares CD30 membrane/Golgi staining but lacks CD20/PAX5 and usually expresses T-cell or cytotoxic markers.
cHL cells are CD15+, weak PAX5+, CD45-negative and embedded in an inflammatory background.
PMBL has weaker heterogeneous CD30, sclerosis and CD23/MAL/PD-L1 positivity with a mediastinal presentation.
Embryonal carcinoma is CD30-positive but keratin, OCT3/4 and SALL4-positive and CD45-negative.

4155.recognize_zh: 成片中到大型淋巴細胞，核圓到稍不規則、染色質細緻分散呈母細胞樣、核仁小，胞質稀少，並可見凋亡細胞；這種像淋巴母細胞的形態是 blastoid 型套細胞淋巴瘤，需 cyclin D1/SOX11 確認並與淋巴母細胞淋巴瘤區分。
features: Diffuse sheets of medium-to-large lymphoid cells
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with finely dispersed blastic chromatin
Small inconspicuous nucleoli; scant cytoplasm
Scattered apoptotic bodies and dark crushed nuclei
Occasional pink hyalinized small vessels; no starry-sky pattern
4155.describe_en: Lymph node section shows diffuse sheets of monotonous medium-to-large lymphoid cells with round to slightly irregular nuclei, finely dispersed blast-like chromatin, small nucleoli and scant cytoplasm. Scattered apoptotic bodies are present, but a starry-sky pattern is not evident. Occasional hyalinized small vessels are seen. The morphology resembles lymphoblasts; in combination with CD5+ and cyclin D1+ or SOX11+ B-cell phenotype, findings are consistent with the blastoid variant of mantle cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblastic lymphoma is TdT-positive and cyclin D1-negative despite identical blastic chromatin.
Burkitt lymphoma shows a starry-sky pattern with squared-off cells, CD10+/BCL2-, Ki-67 near 100% and MYC rearrangement.
DLBCL cells are larger with vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli and lack cyclin D1/SOX11.
Myeloid sarcoma is MPO/CD33/CD117-positive and CD20/PAX5-negative, often with eosinophilic myelocytes.

3835.recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓切片中造血細胞被一片淡粉紅、纖維狀的間質取代，其中散布卵圓至梭形核的類上皮組織球、淋巴球與少量嗜酸性球及核碎片，為邊界不清的肉芽腫反應。
features: Loose infiltrate of epithelioid histiocytes with oval to elongated vesicular nuclei and pale eosinophilic cytoplasm
Admixed small lymphocytes and scattered eosinophils
Pale pink, loosely fibrillar/granular stromal background replacing hematopoietic elements
Scattered karyorrhectic nuclear debris
No well-formed multinucleated giant cells or caseous necrosis in this field
3835.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at high power shows replacement of hematopoietic tissue by a loose infiltrate of epithelioid histiocytes with oval to elongated vesicular nuclei, admixed lymphocytes, scattered eosinophils, and karyorrhectic debris in a pale, loosely fibrillar stroma. Well-formed giant cells and caseous necrosis are not seen. Findings are consistent with a poorly formed granulomatous process; in HIV infection, AFB and GMS stains and cultures are recommended to exclude mycobacterial and fungal infection.

ddx.vs: Gelatinous transformation has amorphous pale extracellular material with few cells and no epithelioid histiocyte aggregates.
Fibrosis shows spindled fibroblasts with collagen and atypical megakaryocytes, whereas histiocytes here are CD68 positive epithelioid cells.
Hodgkin involvement contains CD30+/CD15+ Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells in the mixed infiltrate, which are not identified here.

ddx.dx: Mycobacterium avium complex infection with foamy histiocytes
ddx.vs: MAC in advanced HIV may show sheets of foamy histiocytes packed with AFB-positive bacilli rather than well-formed granulomas; AFB stain separates them.

3771.recognize_zh: 中倍下淋巴結結構瀰漫消失，背景以小淋巴球和淡粉紅細胞質的組織球為主，其間散在核大、空泡狀並有清楚核仁的大細胞，不成片，符合 T 細胞／組織球豐富型大 B 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Diffuse effacement of nodal architecture without follicles in this field
Scattered isolated large cells with vesicular nuclei, prominent nucleoli and perinuclear clearing
Predominant background of small lymphocytes and histiocytes with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm
Large cells are evenly dispersed and do not form clusters or sheets
No nodular pattern or prominent sclerosis
3771.describe_en: Section of lymph node shows diffuse effacement of architecture by a polymorphous infiltrate composed mainly of small lymphocytes and histiocytes with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm. Scattered throughout are isolated large atypical cells with vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli, without formation of sheets. No residual follicles or nodular pattern are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with T-cell/histiocyte-rich large B-cell lymphoma; immunohistochemistry is required to confirm CD20+ large B cells within a CD3+ T-cell and CD68+ histiocyte background and to exclude Hodgkin lymphoma.

ddx.dx: Nodular lymphocyte-predominant Hodgkin lymphoma (diffuse THRLBCL-like pattern)
ddx.vs: NLPHL shows at least focal nodules with CD21+ FDC meshworks and small B cells, which are absent in THRLBCL.
HRS cells are CD30+/CD15+ and CD45-, typically with eosinophils and plasma cells in the background.
DLBCL NOS shows sheets of large cells rather than sparse large cells in a T-cell/histiocyte-rich background.
Lennert lymphoma has numerous epithelioid histiocytes but the atypical cells are small-to-medium CD3+ T cells.

3707.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片免疫組織化學染色：右上大片為均一、陰性（藍色）的中型細胞呈片狀浸潤，取代正常造血；左下殘存棕色陽性的小細胞聚集。陰性片狀細胞群與陽性殘存細胞形成對比，代表移植後復發的 AML 芽細胞浸潤，但抗原未標示，判讀受限。
features: Sheet-like infiltrate of monotonous, medium-sized immunonegative cells occupying most of the field (upper right)
Residual cluster of small immunopositive (brown) cells confined to the lower left
Scattered single positive cells within the negative infiltrate
Bone trabecula at upper left edge with paratrabecular extension of the negative infiltrate
Antigen is not labeled, limiting specific interpretation
3707.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain of a bone marrow trephine biopsy shows a large, sheet-like infiltrate of monotonous medium-sized cells that are negative for the applied marker, effacing normal marrow architecture adjacent to a bony trabecula. A band of residual small immunopositive cells is present at the lower left, with only scattered positive cells within the infiltrate. The antigen is not specified; if this represents a maturing myeloid or lineage marker (e.g., MPO or CD3), the pattern indicates replacement of residual hematopoiesis by a negative neoplastic population. In the clinical setting of prior stem cell transplant, the findings are consistent with recurrent acute myeloid leukemia, to be confirmed with CD34/CD117 immunostains, flow cytometry, and chimerism studies.

ddx.vs: Infiltrate is composed of B cells positive for CD20/CD79a and often EBER, rather than CD34/CD117-positive myeloid blasts.
Regeneration shows heterogeneous maturing trilineage cells with clusters of erythroid and megakaryocytic cells, not monotonous sheets.
May be morphologically identical; chimerism analysis distinguishes donor from recipient origin.

ddx.dx: Myeloid sarcoma-like marrow involvement by other tumor
ddx.vs: Non-hematopoietic tumors are CD45-negative and express keratin or other lineage markers.

3643.recognize_zh: 高度細胞化的骨髓抹片中，散布大量帶粗大橘紅色顆粒的嗜酸性球，其中不少是細胞核圓形、顆粒偏紫紅的嗜酸性骨髓細胞（eosinophilic myelocytes），可判斷為嗜酸性球增多。
features: Markedly increased eosinophils and eosinophilic precursors scattered throughout the field
Coarse refractile orange-red granules filling the cytoplasm of mature eosinophils
Eosinophilic myelocytes/metamyelocytes with round to indented nuclei and admixed purplish (basophilic-staining) immature granules
Hypercellular aspirate with background neutrophilic precursors, erythroid precursors and lymphocytes
No obvious increase in blasts or clustered atypical cells at this magnification
3643.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is hypercellular. There is a striking increase in eosinophils at all stages of maturation, including numerous eosinophilic myelocytes and metamyelocytes with coarse orange-red granules, some with admixed immature purple granules. The background contains maturing neutrophilic and erythroid precursors without an apparent increase in blasts at this magnification. Findings are consistent with marrow eosinophilia; correlation with peripheral eosinophil count, clinical history (parasites, drugs, allergy) and, if persistent, cytogenetic/molecular studies (PDGFRA, PDGFRB, FGFR1, JAK2 rearrangements, CBFB::MYH11) is recommended.

ddx.vs: Shows increased myeloblasts/monoblasts with abnormal eosinophils bearing large dark basophilic granules, whereas this field shows orderly eosinophil maturation without a visible blast excess.

May look morphologically similar with maturing eosinophils and often increased atypical mast cells, so FIP1L1::PDGFRA testing rather than morphology is needed to separate it from reactive eosinophilia.
Features spindled mast cells with metachromatic granules and CD25/CD117 positive aggregates, which are not seen in this aspirate field.

3515.recognize_zh: 背景中可見大量大型、部分低顆粒的血小板，大小接近甚至超過紅血球，右上角有一個核質比高的未成熟單核細胞；在急性骨髓性白血病中出現明顯血小板異常，應聯想到 inv(3)/t(3;3)（MECOM）。
features: Numerous large and giant platelets, many approaching RBC size, some hypogranular with pale cytoplasm
Single mononuclear cell (upper right) with high N:C ratio and dark nucleus, compatible with a blast
Red cells overlapping in a thicker area of the smear, limiting RBC morphology assessment
Marked variation in platelet size and granulation
3515.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear, taken from a relatively thick area, shows numerous platelets with striking anisocytosis, including many large and giant forms, some of which are hypogranular. A single immature mononuclear cell with a high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, compatible with a blast, is present at the edge of the field. Red cell morphology cannot be reliably assessed due to overlap. In the context of acute myeloid leukemia, the prominent platelet abnormalities are suggestive of AML with inv(3)(q21q26.2) or t(3;3)(q21;q26.2) (GATA2/MECOM); cytogenetic confirmation is required.

ddx.vs: Inherited macrothrombocytopenias lack circulating blasts and MYH9 disorders show Döhle-like neutrophil inclusions.
MDS lacks a leukemic blast population; separation from inv(3) AML depends on blast percentage and karyotype.
AMKL shows megakaryoblasts with cytoplasmic blebs and CD41/CD61 expression, and requires ancillary studies rather than platelet morphology alone.

3451.recognize_zh: 數顆紅血球內散佈許多大小不一、深藍紫色的粗顆粒，均勻分布於整個細胞質，就是粗嗜鹼性點彩（coarse basophilic stippling）；部分含點彩的細胞偏藍灰色（多染性）。
features: Several red cells contain numerous coarse, dark blue-purple punctate granules distributed evenly throughout the cell
Stippled cells are normal-sized to slightly small, some with faint polychromatophilic tint
Surrounding red cells are largely normocytic and normochromic with central pallor
Occasional red cells contain a single small dot-like inclusion; one cell at lower left shows a refractile artifact
Few scattered platelets; no leukocytes in field
3451.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a background of largely normocytic, normochromic red cells with rouleaux-free monolayer. Multiple red cells contain coarse, evenly dispersed blue-purple granules consistent with coarse basophilic stippling (aggregated ribosomes/RNA). Some stippled cells are slightly polychromatophilic. No parasites or leukocyte abnormalities are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with coarse basophilic stippling, which should prompt consideration of lead poisoning, thalassemia, pyrimidine 5'-nucleotidase deficiency, or dyserythropoiesis.

ddx.vs: Pappenheimer bodies are few, clustered at the cell periphery and stain with Prussian blue, whereas basophilic stippling is numerous, diffusely distributed and iron-negative.
Plasmodium forms show ring cytoplasm with a chromatin dot or Schüffner/Maurer dots within an identifiable parasite, not uniform punctate granules filling the cell.

ddx.dx: Fine basophilic stippling of polychromatophilic cells
ddx.vs: Fine stippling consists of tiny, barely resolvable dots seen in reticulocyte-rich states, while coarse stippling has distinct, large granules.
Overlying platelets are larger, granular and often have a halo and lie in a different focal plane rather than multiple uniform intracellular dots.

3195.recognize_zh: 淋巴結竇內擠滿大量淡粉紅、細胞質豐富的組織球，把殘存的淋巴濾泡（中央）與淋巴細胞團圍繞分隔，呈現竇組織球大量擴張的樣式，符合 Rosai-Dorfman 病（竇組織球增生合併巨大淋巴結病）。
features: Markedly distended sinuses filled with sheets of large histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm
Histiocyte nuclei round to oval, vesicular, without significant atypia at this magnification
Residual lymphoid follicle with germinal center surrounded by a mantle of small lymphocytes
Clusters of small lymphocytes and plasma cells in the medullary cords between sinuses
Emperipolesis may be present but cannot be confidently resolved at this power
3195.describe_en: Lymph node section at low-to-medium power shows marked expansion of sinuses by sheets of large histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and bland vesicular nuclei. The sinusoidal histiocytes surround a residual reactive follicle and compress interfollicular lymphoid tissue, which contains small lymphocytes and plasma cells. Emperipolesis cannot be reliably assessed at this magnification. Findings are consistent with sinus histiocytosis with massive lymphadenopathy (Rosai-Dorfman disease); confirmation by S100, CD68/CD163 and OCT2 immunostains and absence of CD1a/langerin is recommended.

ddx.vs: Reactive sinus histiocytosis has smaller histiocytes without emperipolesis and they are S100 negative, whereas Rosai-Dorfman histiocytes are large, S100 positive and show emperipolesis.
LCH cells have grooved, reniform nuclei with eosinophils and are CD1a/langerin positive, unlike Rosai-Dorfman histiocytes.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma or melanoma in sinuses
ddx.vs: Metastatic cells show nuclear atypia, cohesive nests and keratin or melanocytic markers, whereas these histiocytes are bland and S100/CD68 positive without HMB45/Melan-A.

ddx.dx: Anaplastic large cell lymphoma, sinusoidal pattern
ddx.vs: ALCL cells are pleomorphic hallmark cells with horseshoe nuclei and are CD30 positive, not bland histiocytes.

3323.recognize_zh: 周邊血三顆中型淋巴樣細胞，細胞質豐富淡藍並含小空泡，細胞核卵圓、腎形或雙葉凹陷，染色質中度濃縮；比一般淋巴球細胞質多、核型不規則，符合毛細胞白血病變異型（HCL-v）的循環細胞，但此圖核仁不明顯、毛狀突起也不突出。
features: Three intermediate-sized lymphoid cells, larger than small lymphocytes
Moderate to abundant pale blue cytoplasm with small cytoplasmic vacuoles
Oval to reniform or bilobed/indented nuclei
Moderately condensed chromatin; nucleoli not conspicuous at this resolution
Cytoplasmic borders mostly smooth with only subtle irregularity; well-developed hairy projections are not evident
Background red cells show mild anisopoikilocytosis with occasional fragments
3323.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows three atypical intermediate-sized lymphoid cells in a background of red cells with mild anisopoikilocytosis. The cells have moderate to abundant pale blue cytoplasm with small vacuoles and oval, reniform or bilobed nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin. Distinct nucleoli and well-formed circumferential hairy projections are not evident in this image. The findings are compatible with circulating cells of splenic B-cell lymphoma with prominent nucleoli (formerly hairy cell leukemia variant) in context, but are not specific; flow cytometry (CD11c+, CD103+/-, CD25-, CD123-) and BRAF V600E status are needed to separate it from classic hairy cell leukemia and other splenic lymphomas.

ddx.vs: Classic HCL cells are CD25+, CD123+, annexin A1+ and BRAF V600E-mutated, and classic HCL presents with monocytopenia rather than leukocytosis.
SMZL villous lymphocytes have short polar villi and are CD11c variable, CD103-negative.
Monocytes have folded nuclei with lacy chromatin, grey-blue cytoplasm with fine azurophilic granules, and express CD14 rather than B-cell markers.
Prolymphocytes have a single prominent central nucleolus and less abundant cytoplasm.

3387.recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸的骨髓顆粒（particle）中，同一低倍視野就有四到五顆大型、細胞質豐富的巨核細胞，散在許多脂肪空泡與造血細胞之間；單一顆粒內巨核細胞數目明顯增加，就是巨核細胞增生的抹片表現。
features: Bone marrow particle with numerous fat vacuoles and densely packed hematopoietic cells
At least four to five large megakaryocytes within a single low-power field
Megakaryocytes with abundant granular cytoplasm and large lobulated nuclei obscured by thickness
Megakaryocytes dispersed rather than forming tight clusters
Thick particle area limits assessment of individual megakaryocyte morphology
3387.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular particle with numerous fat vacuoles. At least four to five large megakaryocytes with abundant granular cytoplasm are present within a single low-power field, indicating increased megakaryocyte numbers. The megakaryocytes appear dispersed rather than tightly clustered, although the thickness of the particle limits evaluation of nuclear lobation and dysplasia. Findings are consistent with megakaryocytic hyperplasia; correlation with platelet count, core biopsy morphology and, if thrombocytosis is present, MPN driver mutation testing is recommended.

ddx.vs: ET shows large hyperlobated staghorn megakaryocytes in loose clusters with persistent thrombocytosis and a JAK2, CALR or MPL mutation.
PMF megakaryocytes are atypical with cloud-like hyperchromatic nuclei in tight clusters, accompanied by reticulin fibrosis on biopsy.
In ITP megakaryocytes are increased but morphologically normal with peripheral thrombocytopenia.
Osteoclasts have multiple discrete round nuclei, and histiocytes are smaller with vacuolated cytoplasm.

3131.recognize_zh: 鐵染色（Prussian blue）下，紅色對比染色的有核紅血球母細胞胞質中有藍色含鐵顆粒，部分沿核周排列成環狀或半環，即環狀鐵粒母細胞（ring sideroblasts）。
features: Iron stain with red nuclear counterstain on bone marrow aspirate
Erythroid precursors containing coarse blue-green siderotic granules in the cytoplasm
Granules arranged in a perinuclear partial or complete ring in several erythroblasts
Scattered extracellular or background iron granules
Larger cells with pale nuclei (earlier precursors) lack granules
3131.describe_en: Prussian blue-stained bone marrow aspirate shows erythroid precursors containing coarse blue siderotic granules. In several erythroblasts the granules encircle a substantial portion of the nucleus in a perinuclear ring. Individual granule counts per cell cannot be precisely assessed at this resolution. Findings are consistent with ring sideroblasts (defined as at least 5 granules covering at least one-third of the nuclear circumference).

ddx.vs: Normal sideroblasts contain only a few fine granules scattered randomly in the cytoplasm rather than a perinuclear ring.
Macrophage iron is clumped within large histiocytes with abundant cytoplasm, not in erythroblasts around the nucleus.
Precipitate lies in a different focal plane and is distributed randomly over cells and background.

3003.recognize_zh: 免疫組化染色（推測為 CD20 等 B 細胞標記）下，棕色陽性的大型淋巴樣細胞只局限在微血管與小血管管腔內，周邊實質細胞與基質均為陰性，這種腔內分布是血管內大 B 細胞淋巴瘤的關鍵表現。
features: Brown membranous/cytoplasmic immunostaining of large lymphoid cells confined within vascular lumina
Positive cells line and fill capillaries and small vessels, some forming intraluminal clusters
Large cells with round vesicular nuclei and moderate cytoplasm
Surrounding parenchymal and stromal cells negative (blue hematoxylin counterstain)
Numerous empty round spaces in the background (likely adipose or dilated spaces); organ of origin not identifiable
3003.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain (a B-cell marker, likely CD20) shows strongly positive large lymphoid cells located exclusively within the lumina of capillaries and small vessels, where they line vessel walls and form small intraluminal clusters. The positive cells have large round vesicular nuclei, whereas the surrounding parenchymal and stromal cells are negative, and there is no extravascular mass of positive cells. Numerous empty round spaces are present in the background; the tissue of origin cannot be determined from this field. The strictly intravascular distribution of large B cells is consistent with intravascular large B-cell lymphoma.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma with vascular involvement
ddx.vs: Conventional DLBCL forms extravascular sheets or masses, whereas IVLBCL cells are restricted to vessel lumina without a tumor mass.
Intravascular NK/T-cell lymphoma is CD20-negative and positive for CD3/CD56/cytotoxic markers with EBER positivity.

ddx.dx: Leukemic intravascular spread (e.g., circulating leukemia or reactive lymphocytes)
ddx.vs: Circulating leukemia shows cells in larger vessels proportionate to blood counts, while IVLBCL fills small capillaries with large B cells despite normal blood counts.
Carcinoma emboli are cohesive and keratin-positive/CD45-negative, unlike discohesive CD20-positive lymphoma cells.

2811.recognize_zh: 成群的中型母細胞，核圓、染色質均勻細緻、核仁不明顯，細胞質極少、無顆粒，形態一致；周邊可見殘存的顆粒球系細胞與破碎細胞，符合前驅 B 細胞淋巴母細胞白血病。
features: Clusters of monotonous small-to-medium blasts
Very high N:C ratio with a thin rim of pale basophilic agranular cytoplasm
Round nuclei with fine, evenly dispersed chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous or faint
No Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules
Residual maturing granulocytes and smudged cells at the periphery; scattered red cells
2811.describe_en: The smear shows clusters of monotonous small-to-medium blasts with round nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and a thin rim of agranular basophilic cytoplasm. Auer rods and granules are not seen. Residual maturing granulocytes and smudged cells are present at the periphery. The morphology favors lymphoblasts, and findings are consistent with B-lymphoblastic leukemia pending immunophenotypic confirmation (CD19, CD10, CD22, TdT, CD34) and cytogenetic/molecular risk stratification.

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts are MPO/Sudan black positive in >=3% and may contain Auer rods, whereas lymphoblasts are MPO-negative.
T-ALL is cytoplasmic CD3-positive and B-lineage-negative, often with a mediastinal mass.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with prominent lipid vacuoles, surface Ig and are TdT-negative with MYC rearrangement.
Hematogones are smaller with more condensed chromatin and show a normal maturation continuum by flow cytometry.

2683.recognize_zh: 淋巴球核有角、染色質粗且深染，箭頭處核與細胞質交界有一條細長、透明無色的線狀結構，為細胞質內結晶；細胞質淡且邊緣不規則，右下角另有一顆較大的顆粒性細胞可作大小對照。
features: Small-to-medium lymphocyte with angulated nucleus
Dense, coarsely clumped chromatin; no nucleoli
Moderate pale cytoplasm with irregular, slightly scalloped outline
Thin colorless crystalline sliver at the nuclear-cytoplasmic interface (arrow)
Partially visible larger granulated cell at lower right; normochromic red cells
2683.describe_en: High-power view of a peripheral blood smear shows a lymphocyte with an angulated nucleus, dense coarsely clumped chromatin and a moderate rim of pale cytoplasm with an irregular border. A thin, unstained, linear crystalline inclusion lies along the nuclear margin (arrow). A larger granulated cell is partially visible at the edge, and red cells are normochromic. Findings are consistent with a crystalline inclusion in a malignant lymphocyte; demonstration in multiple cells and immunophenotyping help exclude artifact and classify the lymphoproliferative disorder.

ddx.vs: Auer rods are stained reddish-purple rods in myeloblasts, not colorless inclusions in mature lymphoid cells.

ddx.dx: Artifactual cleft between nucleus and cytoplasm
ddx.vs: Retraction clefts are irregular and common in thick areas, whereas crystals have sharp, straight parallel edges.
Sézary cells show cerebriform, grooved nuclei and may have perinuclear vacuoles but lack rod-shaped crystals.

2427.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中看不到可辨認的完整細胞，只有一片藍紫色、邊界模糊的無結構物質夾雜大小不一的空泡，細胞核與細胞質界線消失，符合骨髓壞死抹片的特徵。
features: No intact, identifiable hematopoietic cells; cell borders and nuclear detail are lost
Amorphous, smudged basophilic to purple granular material forming a continuous background
Numerous round, variably sized clear vacuoles (lipid/degenerated cell remnants)
Poor staining definition throughout the particle, typical of necrotic aspirate material
2427.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (Wright-Giemsa) shows a particle-like aggregate composed of amorphous, smudged basophilic material with numerous clear vacuoles of varying size. Individual hematopoietic cells cannot be identified, and nuclear and cytoplasmic detail is lost throughout the field. No recognizable blasts, maturing myeloid or erythroid elements are present. Findings are consistent with bone marrow necrosis; correlation with the trephine biopsy is required to establish the extent and underlying cause.

ddx.vs: In a thick smear intact cells are still recognizable at the thinner edges, whereas necrotic material shows no preserved cell outlines anywhere.
Gelatinous material is pink-purple, homogeneous and acellular with few scattered intact cells, rather than granular debris with vacuolated degenerated cells.
Delayed smear preparation causes swollen, vacuolated but still individually recognizable cells, not confluent amorphous debris.

2299.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中大型細胞具有大量藍灰色、帶細小嗜天青顆粒的細胞質，細胞核偏心、圓到卵圓形、染色質細緻，細胞邊緣有突起，為典型單核母細胞/前單核球外觀。
features: Large cells with abundant blue-gray cytoplasm containing fine azurophilic granules
Eccentric round to oval nuclei, some slightly indented
Fine, delicate chromatin
Cytoplasmic blebs and irregular pseudopod-like borders
Monotonous infiltrate with red cells in background; no Auer rods seen
2299.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows sheets of large cells with abundant blue-gray cytoplasm containing fine azurophilic granules and irregular cytoplasmic borders with blebs. Nuclei are eccentric, round to oval or slightly indented, with fine delicate chromatin. No Auer rods are identified and maturing granulocytes are inconspicuous. Findings are consistent with acute monoblastic/monocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: AMML shows a significant neutrophil lineage component (at least 20%) with MPO-positive myeloblasts, not a pure monocytic population.
Plasma cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with a perinuclear hof and clock-face chromatin and are CD138 positive, unlike granular gray monocytic cytoplasm.
Microgranular APL has bilobed nuclei and strong MPO with PML::RARA, whereas monoblasts are NSE positive and MPO weak.

2107.recognize_zh: 中央嗜中性球胞質內滿布深紫色粗大毒性顆粒（toxic granulation），在細胞左上方胞質邊緣可見一小片淡藍灰色、無顆粒的斑塊，即 Döhle body，兩者並存提示感染或發炎反應。
features: Neutrophil with coarse dark purple toxic granules throughout the cytoplasm
Small pale blue-gray agranular cytoplasmic patch at the upper-left periphery (Döhle body)
Hyposegmented/bilobed nucleus with coarse clumped chromatin
Surrounding red cells normochromic; ghost-like pale red cell adjacent
Purple fragmented object at lower left, likely a smudged cell or platelet clump
2107.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at oil immersion shows a neutrophil with prominent coarse dark purple toxic granulation and a small pale blue-gray agranular patch at the cytoplasmic periphery, representing a Döhle body. The nucleus is bilobed with coarse chromatin. Surrounding red cells are largely unremarkable. Findings are consistent with toxic changes of neutrophils (toxic granulation and Döhle body), typically reflecting infection, inflammation, burns, pregnancy, or G-CSF therapy.

ddx.vs: MYH9 inclusions are larger, more spindle-shaped, present in most neutrophils, and accompanied by giant platelets and thrombocytopenia without toxic granulation.
Alder-Reilly granules are large dark granules present in all leukocyte types including lymphocytes and are not associated with Döhle bodies.
Chédiak-Higashi shows giant, irregular fused granules rather than fine coarse toxic granules with a blue cytoplasmic patch.

2043.recognize_zh: 多顆大型細胞的核被粗大紫色顆粒覆蓋，數顆呈雙葉或腎形核；中下方一顆細胞質充滿成束的棒狀物（疑似 Auer rods 堆積），左上一顆則有粗顆粒延伸到細胞邊緣，符合顆粒過多型 APL。
features: Large cells with abundant cytoplasm and coarse azurophilic granules overlying the nucleus
Reniform to bilobed nuclei in several cells
One central cell shows coarse rod-like/streaky cytoplasmic inclusions suggestive of numerous Auer rods (faggot-like cell)
Granules extend into irregular cytoplasmic projections in some cells
Monotonous population without maturing granulocytes in field
Background red cells with drying artifact
2043.describe_en: Smear shows a population of large abnormal cells with abundant cytoplasm containing dense coarse azurophilic granules that overlie and obscure the nucleus. Nuclei are reniform to bilobed. One cell in the lower center contains coarse streaky inclusions suggestive of multiple Auer rods (faggot cell), although individual rods are not sharply resolved at this magnification. Maturing granulocytes are not seen in this field. Findings are consistent with hypergranular acute promyelocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: t(8;21) blasts typically carry a single long Auer rod with a prominent hof, whereas multiple bundled Auer rods (faggot cells) and granule-obscured bilobed nuclei point to APL.
Reactive promyelocytes have round nuclei with a clear hof, lack Auer rods, and occur with normal maturation to neutrophils.

ddx.dx: APL-like morphology with RARA-variant or non-RARA fusion
ddx.vs: Morphology cannot separate PML::RARA from variant partners such as ZBTB16::RARA; FISH/RT-PCR is required because variants may be ATRA-resistant.

1915.recognize_zh: 周邊血中大量圓形細胞，胞質充滿粗大深紫黑色的嗜鹼性顆粒並遮蓋細胞核，部分細胞顆粒較少可見細緻染色質；與中上方正常的帶狀中性球相比，這些異常嗜鹼性細胞明顯增加，符合急性嗜鹼性白血病。
features: Increased numbers of round cells packed with coarse dark purple-black basophilic granules obscuring nuclear detail
Some cells with less densely packed granules revealing round nuclei with finer chromatin (immature forms)
Cells slightly larger than red cells, with little visible agranular cytoplasm
Band neutrophil with fine pale granules at upper center for comparison
Red cells with rouleaux-like stacking and a scattered platelet
1915.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous round cells containing coarse, dark purple-black basophilic granules that obscure the nucleus, with some less granular forms showing round nuclei with finer chromatin. A band neutrophil is present for comparison, and red cells show rouleaux-like stacking. Blasts without granules are not clearly identified in this field. Findings are consistent with acute basophilic leukemia in the appropriate clinical and immunophenotypic context; CML and other BCR::ABL1-positive or t(6;9) leukemias with basophilia must be excluded.

ddx.vs: Mature basophils in CML or reactive states have segmented nuclei and occur with a full granulocytic left shift, and CML is BCR::ABL1-positive.
Mast cells are larger with oval eccentric nuclei and CD117/tryptase positivity, with KIT D816V mutation.
Toxic granulation shows dark granules in neutrophils with segmented nuclei and pink background cytoplasm, not granules obscuring a round nucleus.

1851.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中多顆嗜伊紅系前驅細胞的細胞質布滿大而深紫色的顆粒（異常嗜伊紅球），同時混有核折疊的單核樣胚細胞，顆粒粗大深染又夾雜單核分化，是 inv(16) AML 的典型組合。
features: Mixed population of blasts and monocytoid cells with folded nuclei and moderate cytoplasm
Several eosinophil precursors with large, coarse dark purple basophilic-staining granules
Granules often admixed with orange eosinophilic granules in the same cell
Fine nuclear chromatin in blasts; some cells with visible nucleoli
Scattered small nucleated red cells/lymphocytes; granular debris from ruptured cells in background
1851.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows increased blasts and monocytoid cells with folded nuclei and fine chromatin, admixed with numerous eosinophil precursors whose cytoplasm contains large, coarse, dark purple basophilic-staining granules together with eosinophilic granules. Free granules from disrupted cells are present in the background. Mature neutrophils are few. Findings are consistent with acute myelomonocytic leukemia with abnormal eosinophils, suggestive of AML with inv(16)(p13.1q22) or t(16;16)(p13.1;q22); CBFB-MYH11.

ddx.vs: Reactive eosinophils are mature with uniform orange granules and bilobed nuclei, without increased blasts or large basophilic-staining granules.
CML shows a full granulocytic maturation spectrum with basophilia and eosinophilia and BCR-ABL1 rather than increased myelomonocytic blasts with dysplastic eosinophils.
AMML NOS lacks abnormal eosinophils and the CBFB-MYH11 fusion on cytogenetic or molecular testing.

1787.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中一顆白血球的細胞質內（箭頭）有一個圓形、帶透明外圈（莢膜樣光暈）的酵母菌體，符合被吞噬的隱球菌（Cryptococcus）。
features: Single leukocyte (phagocyte) with a dense, irregularly lobulated nucleus and pale, finely vacuolated cytoplasm
Intracytoplasmic round yeast form (arrow) with a central lavender body surrounded by a thin clear refractile halo, consistent with a capsule
A second, smaller faint round body appears adjacent to the arrowed organism, possibly another yeast or budding form
No hyphae or pseudohyphae identified
Background red cells are out of focus in a thick area of the smear; scattered platelets
1787.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a leukocyte containing an intracytoplasmic round yeast form with a clear halo suggestive of a polysaccharide capsule (arrow); a second smaller round body is adjacent. No hyphae are seen, and the red cells are out of focus in this thick area, limiting assessment of the background. Findings are consistent with phagocytosed yeast, suggestive of disseminated Cryptococcus infection; confirmation by cryptococcal antigen testing, blood culture, and mucicarmine or India ink staining is recommended.

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts are smaller (2-4 um), oval, and typically multiple within a phagocyte with a pseudocapsular clear space, whereas Cryptococcus is larger, round, variably sized, and often single with narrow-based budding.
Candida yeasts are small oval budding forms that often form pseudohyphae and lack a thick capsule.
An ingested red cell is pink-orange and homogeneous without a refractile capsular halo or budding.
A vacuole is empty and lacks the central stained yeast body surrounded by a defined wall.

1723.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中兩顆中性球的細胞核只分成兩葉，其中一顆呈兩個圓葉以細絲相連的眼鏡狀（pince-nez），另一顆呈花生或腎形，染色質粗糙團塊狀且細胞質顆粒偏少，符合假性Pelger-Huet細胞。
features: Two mature-sized neutrophils with hypolobated nuclei
Lower cell: bilobed nucleus with two round lobes joined by a thin strand (pince-nez or spectacle form)
Upper cell: nonsegmented peanut- to kidney-shaped nucleus
Coarsely clumped, mature chromatin inappropriate for a band form
Pale cytoplasm with sparse fine granules, suggesting hypogranularity
Background red cells with mild poikilocytosis including occasional target and teardrop forms
1723.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two neutrophils with hypolobated nuclei: one bilobed with two round lobes connected by a thin chromatin bridge (pince-nez form) and one with a nonsegmented peanut-shaped nucleus. Both nuclei have coarsely clumped mature chromatin, and the cytoplasm appears relatively hypogranular. The red cells show mild poikilocytosis. Findings are consistent with pseudo-Pelger-Huet (acquired Pelger-Huet) neutrophils, which should prompt evaluation for myelodysplastic syndrome or a drug effect (e.g., mycophenolate, tacrolimus, valproate).

ddx.vs: The inherited anomaly affects nearly all neutrophils uniformly with normal granulation and no cytopenias, whereas acquired pseudo-Pelger cells are a subset often with hypogranulation and dysplasia in other lineages.
Band forms have a curved, uniformly thick horseshoe nucleus with less condensed chromatin, not two discrete round lobes with coarse clumped chromatin.
Immature myeloid cells have round or kidney-shaped nuclei with finer chromatin and more abundant specific granules.

1531.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中可見多個大型芽細胞（藍色胞質、細緻染色質），並混有帶橘粉色顆粒胞質的前骨髓細胞與骨髓細胞，呈現「芽細胞加上顆粒球成熟」的組合，這是 t(8;21) AML 常見的有成熟分化型態。
features: Increased blasts with moderate basophilic cytoplasm, fine chromatin and round to indented nuclei
Admixed maturing granulocytes (promyelocytes, myelocytes) with salmon-pink granular cytoplasm
Some larger granulated cells with abnormal-appearing, poorly condensed nuclei suggesting dysgranulopoiesis
Scattered small lymphocytes and erythroid precursors
Prominent red cell rouleaux, likely reflecting a thick smear area
1531.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows an increase in blasts with moderate basophilic cytoplasm and fine nuclear chromatin, accompanied by maturing granulocytic cells including promyelocytes and myelocytes with orange-pink granular cytoplasm. Some granulocytic precursors appear large with abnormal nuclear-cytoplasmic maturation. Scattered lymphocytes and erythroid precursors are present, and red cells show rouleaux, probably related to smear thickness. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with maturation and are compatible with AML with t(8;21)(q22;q22.1); RUNX1::RUNX1T1 in the appropriate genetic context.

ddx.vs: APL shows a predominance of abnormal hypergranular promyelocytes with folded nuclei and Auer rod bundles rather than blasts with orderly granulocytic maturation.
MDS with increased blasts has fewer than 20% blasts, but t(8;21) defines AML regardless of blast count.
Myeloma would show atypical plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and perinuclear hofs rather than myeloblasts and granulocytic precursors.

123.recognize_zh: 骨髓形態只見細胞量增加、紅血球系與三系造血皆存在，並無特異性；真正定診的線索是 Sanger 定序圖中 VHL c.598 位置由 C 變成單一 T 峰（同型合子 c.598C>T），PCR-RFLP 膠片中亦有一條與其他樣本不同的 268 bp 條帶。
features: Aspirate smear with densely packed red cells in the background, reflecting high hematocrit
Cellular marrow particles and a hypercellular trephine with trilineage hematopoiesis and megakaryocytes
Clusters of basophilic and polychromatic erythroblasts without obvious dysplasia
No morphologic feature on these images that separates congenital from acquired erythrocytosis
Sanger chromatogram: wild-type C peak (upper) versus single homozygous T peak (lower) at VHL c.598
PCR-RFLP gel: one lane with a 268 bp undigested band; other lanes show 187 bp (and faint 81 bp) digested fragments
123.describe_en: The bone marrow aspirate smear shows a densely packed red cell background, cellular particles, and erythroid precursors in clusters admixed with maturing granulocytic cells; no significant dysplasia is evident. The trephine biopsy (H&E) is hypercellular for age with trilineage hematopoiesis and scattered megakaryocytes, without clustering or atypia recognizable at this magnification. Sanger sequencing shows a single T peak at the position occupied by C in the reference trace, indicating homozygous VHL c.598C>T (p.Arg200Trp), and the PCR-RFLP gel shows one sample with an altered restriction pattern (268 bp band) distinct from the digested 187/81 bp pattern of the others. In the setting of erythrocytosis with normal-range erythropoietin and negative family history, findings are consistent with Chuvash polycythemia; the marrow morphology itself is nonspecific.

ddx.vs: Marrow shows panmyelosis with pleomorphic, clustered megakaryocytes and low serum erythropoietin with JAK2 V617F/exon 12 mutation, whereas Chuvash polycythemia is JAK2-negative with normal-to-high EPO and VHL p.Arg200Trp.
Morphology is similarly nonspecific; distinguished by low oxygen saturation, carboxyhemoglobin or elevated EPO from a tumor rather than a germline VHL variant.
Shows a low p50 and often an abnormal HPLC/electrophoresis pattern, whereas HPLC was normal here.
Morphologically identical; separated only by gene sequencing and EPO level (low in EPOR mutation).

captions: Bone marrow composite: aspirate cells (A, C), cellular particle (B) and hypercellular trephine (D)
Sanger sequencing: reference C (top) versus homozygous T (bottom) at VHL c.598
PCR-RFLP agarose gel: 268 bp undigested band in one lane versus 187/81 bp digested fragments

59.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中充滿大量含紫色異染顆粒（metachromatic granules）的大型肥大細胞，許多細胞核呈雙葉或不規則且顆粒散落背景；骨髓切片中片狀淡染細胞呈 tryptase/CD117 陽性並異常表現 CD25 與 CD2，流式也見 CD117 強陽性/CD25+/CD2+ 族群（18%），符合肥大細胞白血病。
features: BM aspirate: sheets of large mast cells with abundant cytoplasm packed with coarse purple metachromatic granules, many degranulated with granules scattered in the background
Atypical mast cells: round to oval, indented, bilobed and binucleated nuclei with open chromatin; variable hypogranulation
BM biopsy: hypercellular marrow with sheets of medium-to-large cells with pale granular cytoplasm and oval/indented nuclei, admixed megakaryocytes
IHC: diffuse sheets positive for tryptase-type granular and membranous CD117 staining; aberrant weak CD25 and CD2 in mast cells
Small bowel: lamina propria diffusely infiltrated by monotonous mast cells between crypts, highlighted by membranous IHC
Flow cytometry: CD117-bright/CD25+ population (18% of events) co-expressing CD2; PB smear shows a circulating granulated mast cell
59.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows neutrophilia with an occasional circulating mast cell with scattered metachromatic granules. The bone marrow aspirate is replaced by numerous large atypical mast cells with abundant coarse metachromatic granules, many with indented, bilobed or binucleated nuclei, and frequent degranulation into the background. The core biopsy is hypercellular with sheets of mast cells with pale granular cytoplasm that are diffusely positive for tryptase and CD117 and aberrantly express CD25 and CD2, and a small-bowel biopsy shows diffuse mucosal infiltration by CD117-positive cells. Flow cytometry identifies a CD117-bright population (18% of events) co-expressing CD25 and CD2. Findings are consistent with systemic mastocytosis, mast cell leukemia (mast cells at least 20% of marrow aspirate nucleated cells).

ddx.vs: ASM has C-findings but mast cells constitute fewer than 20% of nucleated cells on the aspirate smear, unlike the mast-cell-replaced aspirate here.
Basophilic blasts are CD117-negative/dim, CD123+/CD203c+ and tryptase-negative or weak, whereas these cells are CD117-bright and diffusely tryptase-positive.

ddx.dx: Myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with eosinophilia or CML with mast cell proliferation
ddx.vs: These show increased but non-sheeting, typically CD25-negative mast cells with a defining BCR::ABL1 or PDGFRA/FGFR1 rearrangement, rather than sheets of CD25+/CD2+ atypical mast cells.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with abundant granules (e.g. APL-like hypergranular blasts)
ddx.vs: Myeloblasts/promyelocytes are MPO-positive, tryptase-negative and lack the CD117-bright/CD25+ mast cell immunophenotype.

59.stain: Wright-Giemsa, H&E, IHC (tryptase, CD117, CD25, CD2), flow
captions: BM biopsy IHC: granular cytoplasmic staining of sheets of mast cells (likely tryptase)
Peripheral blood: neutrophils, lymphocytes and a circulating granulated mast cell
BM biopsy: hypercellular marrow with sheets of pale mononuclear cells and megakaryocytes (H&E)
BM biopsy high power: atypical cells with pale granular cytoplasm and indented nuclei (H&E)
BM biopsy IHC: strong membranous staining of mast cell sheets (likely CD117)
BM biopsy IHC: weak membranous/cytoplasmic staining of mast cells (likely CD25)
BM biopsy IHC: strong small T cells with weak granular staining of a mast cell (likely CD2)
BM aspirate low power: numerous mast cells with metachromatic granules and background degranulation
BM aspirate high power: atypical, bilobed and binucleated mast cells with variable granulation
Small bowel: lamina propria diffusely infiltrated by monotonous cells (H&E)
Small bowel IHC: membranous staining of infiltrating mast cells between crypts (likely CD117)
Flow cytometry: CD117-bright/CD25+ population (18%) co-expressing CD2
